Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. = Can I explain something, folks? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you so much for sticking by me. body:
You deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuW1uKaoJJophn4v7VwRQKIFXiiIMxmG1XU3byI0fntHtnnQwulN0MChYmjdDqP7LNUzkmkODuXmmbyAtq2-ktu5gU7JIGDkkqpU5Sq7ngjFkXmcZutozY4NSoE-6KSn2tbpqrOqp5BxncHZscGdmW3XU%3D)

Fellow Patriot,

If you watched the second debate, you heard a lot of “career politician talk” from my opponent Bob Casey.

He lied about me, he lied about his record, and he refused to take responsibility for the failures he and the rest of the DC liberals have caused to our economy and at the border.

**On Day One in the Army, you learn to take responsibility for your actions, but Bob Casey is a typical career politician. He takes zero responsibility. **

At one point he even had the nerve to lecture me about the conflict in the Middle East. _I went to West Point, Ranger School, and was a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War and received a Bronze Star for my service._

**I 'm not going to be lectured by a guy who has spent 30 years in elected office with NOTHING to show for it but a weak voting record that lines up 99% of the time with Biden/Harris.**

We had a code at West Point: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. I'm not going to tolerate Bob Casey's lies.

I'm no stranger to tough battles. But with under 3 weeks left until Election Day, the polls locked in a dead heat, and control of the Senate majority hinging on the outcome of my race, **[I need your help in this fight.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuW3excQboFa2S1tqbCyP6m6FstvIos1sOuvOJEd-7h8Lb9F4ZeO-xThCaWpUN-k-aEEg7jV5xhECiSHQUOcUFMXyO8EAVa9gdid3cIn7RNmQWDLU5F80QfrzcyIOU4URVeBTT_qfNmEGW5jJu4TCUO5Q%3D)**
[DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuWyGFfi4W0n_L09wz3uXjK2YndndWZ5HpoFgCbXNbvvk1AGxen2npFkRUT6yCMBoMgBbYuusQqexYkVOYnIWRUgYtnzc1Mvh1p5ryVFui4g988oGqwpGo7Py43gyWgeD0IIn6GxY18dCdzKRWmw3YY9Y%3D)
---

It's not just on the debate stage where I'm facing an onslaught of attacks. **Democrats are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into Pennsylvania to obliterate my chances of flipping the Senate Red.**

I cannot stress enough how close this race is.

We're locked in a tied race.

The outcome of this election will come down to a dogfight in the final days as we fight for _every. single. vote._

That's why I'm asking for your help to fund this final stretch, get my message out, and expose the truth about Bob Casey's failed liberal record.

**[Will you rush in anything you can to help me cut through the noise and get the truth out?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuWyscDsFIGtv-UfMbkrsD8mWEoXtS_yAM0-PH-vQxQodpj4VwuSDtY4ffMwUPYnTn4gVqnGSXf3XB8gjhuRLxCWCDMmLeTxSwav9UTFMCSbWNP8YBLDGcTIdy7NAUcXAkKyxJBZoUrZzUZwbe388GARM%3D)**
[DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuW4NKxmjOsDuRRAD1AOi_l0MlopKlT1xUt7HUa2MB5jgd8f2kn7VeSDDKzNr3o76z5kXR1f60n-h4Xx3sqvL2JFSYTz6jKGijwaB00F2FTIkix5kbJ30g4pWiaBtvlPqPQTs0IPKThnOJIzGvB0TfKbA%3D)
---

**Here 's the truth about Bob Casey.** Bob Casey has accomplished NOTHING after 18 years in the U.S. Senate. He's supported policies that have increased the cost of living, left our border wide open, and he's supported a plan to raise taxes on working Pennsylvanians. He's anti-business and anti-success. And did I mention he wants to get rid of the Senate filibuster?

I'm running for Senate because Pennsylvanians deserve a leader who will fight for the American Dream. YOU deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.

As a West Point cadet, I took an oath of "Duty, Honor, and Country." I live by that motto every day. It's how I've run my campaign and it's how I'll lead in the Senate.

But in order to get there, I need your help today. **[So if you are able, please chip in anything you can to my campaign before time runs out.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b242e4c171e341f6bf3c455cdac419e9&_e=3jQRIy98VytTEDlZucIAbm0Oeo96Xg_dLEXQxi15OAD9Mzg_PXWJxlOWq6Jvf-ouT9QVGmWiFF_So9Nxu2dOgcoppIk-YBPAUHBORxUvgZrcGXIurky5cRyzw2fcu8euFNhJhaXas9UagpZdG9sSfZES_CdFr_7UBRtjye3m7di3v8mVlQ4gY_pcXUbydsLrGvUDvz3xwjNr3SUJfTAUYz0UU05OC8oLYI7mJMcUEymDRDYJfbCdOpIqEBBzptExi-hUbOhQLZq-Cz9sdAmuWw0JpWBD7zX_O30Ry-avfRPsA87jlHivihBloc4aVHO5HM3nPKHpJxMTOTFfXV-52wEtsImRD_B_ITfxJ8t8innDdmE02s0U4InpVAltrrptsbeWoq9oOhCyvLevKPpI4Lk9LNPLLYlcqDWsc_8yC3U%3D)**

Thank you,
Dave McCormick

body:
Let’s talk about what’s important: how this impacts you.

Obama is trying to LIE to Black people about the “hope” that Kamala Harris and Amy Klobuchar offer them.

**But, we’re waking up.[The People Are Coming!](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=82776a7bc7a0493cae4825e0bf001e59&_e=n5ZYS50fs0QvoaNGruWZGEPMymvhv-v9q4xpvgrbrxvvKVJgktIP6UcecGNix0T3e9ZUCUMJ6_kaxcyt5xB9muaOkyckR8YrORhYzpRW6Mr2sFnQeV1VA6fV5qcc56M9bazoyAJI5sIAV5jgSze68x9nwtZenGNBpCGSBZKB1tTGMHfRmIqLgDEH9efsFRJ4VvN9Y0NWl23jj2bQ8k6OGm0Z0r24yOU05lX1GK8As5e_hnCkLjZqWy-JBNPk-DsRqE6ihcn533Hh7o_5Psir_GfnAe7BgQTuk2oeJtdV03eOwPXjqZ-nkruaHJ8n7LYFHyYEoAWBwYhh8mHt1hEXlA%3D%3D)**

There’s no HOPE in welfare, there’s no HOPE in identity politics, there’s no HOPE in globalism.

When they can’t deliver substance, the Democrat Party as a whole resorts to sexual politics. Obama is telling us, “If you don’t vote for Kamala, you’re sexist, you’re misogynist.”

**_No, if we don’t vote for Kamala, it’s because she doesn’t even speak as well as you, Barry!_** And if we knew what we know now, we would go back in time and NOT vote for you, despite how well you spoke and delivered your message.

At least with him, he was articulate enough to trick us. Kamala’s not tricking us, Barack!

**Enough is enough.**

I need your immediate support so I can prove to Barack, Kamala, and Amy Klobuchar that the Black community is DONE being fooled and tricked by their identity and sexual politics.

[**Donate ANY AMOUNT before midnight to help me win and make a MONUMENTAL statement to the Left.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=82776a7bc7a0493cae4825e0bf001e59&_e=n5ZYS50fs0QvoaNGruWZGEPMymvhv-v9q4xpvgrbrxvvKVJgktIP6UcecGNix0T3e9ZUCUMJ6_kaxcyt5xB9muaOkyckR8YrORhYzpRW6Mr2sFnQeV1VA6fV5qcc56M9bazoyAJI5sIAV5jgSze68x9nwtZenGNBpCGSBZKB1tTGMHfRmIqLgDEH9efsFRJ4QhZI_Pz7wEhjL5r-3Y2h0HP3v5_Y-A0DwS0lvy24bmzmzPv1F4ar5N7x2EDO1S7JgIrytGsbLX84I3GI_TzSk-ERSFSazbZNglZx_91MIAWldggLOp_8A643e_0t-gBm7mGmVT6K2vesYdGIA8gVjw%3D%3D)

Godspeed,

body:
I was at a rally in Tucson Friday with President Obama and my buddy Ruben because we’ve got to mobilize every single voter we possibly can over the next 16 days.
#

Peter —
I’m going to keep this quick.
I was at a rally in Tucson Friday with President Obama and my buddy Ruben because we’ve got to mobilize every single voter we possibly can over the next 16 days.
[**To do that, and to win in Arizona, I need you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign. Not next week. Not tomorrow. Right now. Please, chip in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241020-5-160&t=1&akid=3410%2E734936%2E7ddAXY)

I’ve seen too many people questioning Arizona over the last few weeks, and that’s got to stop.
Anywhere from 5-10% of the voters here are still making up their minds. That’s more than enough to swing the result, so we’ve got to move fast and make our case to them. And most of Arizona is going to vote early — around 80% will cast their ballots by November 1st.
**Our window is closing. Fast.**
Ruben can win. And if Ruben wins, it’s all the more likely we defeat Trump here, too. And if we defeat Trump in Arizona we’re almost certain to defeat him nationwide.
But none of that happens if Ruben can’t raise the resources he needs to finish this race strong.

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
Last year, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my midnight goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $10 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. tonight to help me continue our fight for progress this year? name: Ruben Gallego
subject: some things you never get used to
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]
Friends, it’s Ruben.
I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president come after me. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
That’s always going to be weird to me.
But that’s what Donald Trump did when he came here in August. Again in September. On social media earlier this week. And again, this week, in Arizona.
He came back because Arizona is critical to his chances this year, and winning this state is personal for him after we beat him back in 2020.
He knows if he can help defeat me he’s got an open path to the White House. He’s got to go through us to win.
That raises the stakes of our campaign beyond just one seat in the U.S. Senate, and beyond our Senate Majority. This race is about beating Trump, once and for all.
I need you with me to do it.
Any donation at all that you can afford to give helps us fight back. Our average contribution is about $30. Some give more, most give far less. All that matters is that you make that donation, if you can. Can I count on you? Anything you can give will be split with Tim Kaine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

## Catch me if you can!
I'm off to Rome tomorrow for a candidate night at Copper City Brewery. Really, I wish we could do more of these kinds of events -- multiple candidates, in a setting someplace where everyday people tread, such as in a pub or restaurant. If you are in the area, please try to join us for trivia, other games, and candidate stump speeches.
I've got several more press profile interviews this week. Several days of canvassing are planned, plus a few showings of "From Russia with Lev" in Plattsburgh and Saranac Lake.
## Last week was a blur
I was constantly on the go last week for events.
There was the Candidate Panel in Greenwich sponsored by the Journal & Press, where I appeared alongside Assembly Member Carrie Woerner and Greenwich Town Justice Candidate Rachel Clothier. The audience posed questions on topics representing a great blend of issues ranging from hyper-local, to state, to congressional.
There was a [Town Hall in Johnstown](https://substack.com/redirect/5e82077e-7480-40f3-9239-b264c1f105b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that followed a day of door-to-door canvassing. There was a Candidate Panel with the Schoharie County Farm Bureau. These two events are representative of the work I would love to do more of, mostly because the crowd was mixed. Don't get me wrong -- I love my Dems. However, I wish there was an easy way to mix Dems with Republicans and independent voters more frequently. (No -- the hook above my head shown below from the Schoharie County Farm Bureau event was not as ominous as it appears in this photo, lol!)
Also notable last week was the women's march in Plattsburgh and Saranac Lake. After the march, we had a rally at Trinity Park with several local candidate speakers. Really great spirit and attendance!
After the march and rally, my team and I headed to Altona, NY, for a Fundraiser and Comedy Night with the Altona Democratic Committee. Great concept. Again, the crowd was mixed, and I had a Trump heckler on the front row -- seriously -- and not part of the comedy act. The comedy troupe has its own followers who showed up for the show. Good move, Altona Dems!
## We have had some favorable press in recent days.
[Here is the interview](https://substack.com/redirect/bdfaa033-53d9-4d27-a52e-1663b315be08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I did for Mountain Lake PBS.
[WAMC Northeast Public Radio's](https://substack.com/redirect/6da19e53-8952-4b1c-8a3a-539d16c45013?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Pat Bradley provided a nice profile of the campaign.
North Country Public Radio [ran this nice clip](https://substack.com/redirect/f0573fca-a735-4b31-a886-deb75bb6f147?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In case you missed WRGB's Power and Politics clip that ran last week, [here it is again](https://substack.com/redirect/603bfd4f-1432-43dd-baaa-bec0d086c096?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[North Country This Week's St. Lawrence County edition](https://substack.com/redirect/c6cd366d-e894-42c8-9df9-e4e7a03a8d1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) provided several pieces of excellent coverage, including candidate profiles and a column from the county Democratic Co-Chairs, Mike Zagrobelny and Ginger Storey-Welch. I've linked to the online edition of the paper, in case you'd like to page through a glimpse of life in St. Lawrence County.
## My response to a reader's letter
This week's edition of North Country This Week (see link above) included a letter to the editor from the St. Lawrence County Conservative Party Chair Hank Ford that called on me to respond to my allegations about Sefanik's lies. (I have been running an ad in that publication for some weeks now that has some variation on the phrase, "Sick of Stefanik's Lies?")
I don't know if the editors will publish my response. I'm a candidate, and they won't ordinarily publish my letter. However, since Mr. Ford called me out by name, I submitted it. You can read what I sent in (not yet published):
October 20, 2024
I noticed the question posed to me by Hank Ford, Chairman of the St. Lawrence County Conservative Party regarding Stefanik's lies. There are many. Here are a few:
Stefanik lied when she said that she supports our efforts in Ukraine, but then voted against an aid package for military support in Ukraine.
Stefanik lies when she holds herself out as pro-Israel while not rebuking MAGA supporters who display Nazi swastikas. The MAGA Party denigrates prominent Jewish Americans and promotes replacement theory ideology.
In Oct 2022, Stefanik boasted that she secured $12.9 million in aid for rural hospitals in NY21. This is one of several instances in which Stefanik has taken credit for appropriations that she voted against, such as money for fire stations, sewer, and water systems throughout the district. Stefanik has not secured this money. She had voted against this money when she voted against the American Rescue Plan.
Stefanik lies when she says she supports veterans. She voted against the automatic enrollment for veterans in the VA Health Plan. She also voted against money for treatment of burn pit injuries. She supports privatization of the health insurance system for military families.
Stefanik lies when she says she is supportive of those who are on Medicare. Her party is closely aligned with Project 2025, which includes cuts to limit Medicare and lift caps on prescription drug prices for Medicare recipients.
A person who calls those convicted of crimes on Jan 6, 2021 that included brutalization of Capitol Police forces is lying when she says she "backs the blue". Stefanik supports those who brutalized men and women in blue. That is not "backing" law enforcement officers.
Stefanik lies when she blames Kamala Harris for the lack of a border bill. She calls Harris the "border czar"; the United States does not have czars in our government. Stefanik blames Kamala Harris for the failures at the border. Yet, Stefanik could have introduced an immigration bill in Congress, whereas a VP cannot introduce a bill.
Stefanik lies when she says she supports women, and yet does not rebuke Donald Trump for being denigrating to women, nor for being found guilty of sexual assault.
Stefanik lies when she says she supports our Democratic process, and yet refuses to accept the results of the 2020 election.
Stefanik is untrue to her oath of office, in which she swore to support and defend the U.S. Constitution, while her mentor, Donald Trump, openly calls for "termination" of parts of the constitution.
--Paula Collins, Democratic Candidate, NY-21
## What else is new?
Today the headlines included more reports of Trump's rambling, toxic speech, filled with vulgarities and derogatory remarks directed at our current Vice President.
My Republican opponent, Elise Stefanik, by her silence on the antics of the cognitively-deficient, criminal, and crude Donald Trump, proves herself unworthy of serving the people of NY-21. Not only is she sitting idly by, she is actively campaigning for the Trump/Vance ticket in other states, forgetting that she has a race here in upstate New York.
The rumor is that, once elected, Vance and other MAGAs, presumably including Stefanik, will move to invoke the 25th Amendment to remove Trump from office and proceed to implement their grotesque agenda.
## My platform
I'm going to Congress because we need a proactive climate change policy at the federal level. We cannot wait for storms to happen and then react. Congress must pass a policy now to mitigate and develop communities informed by what we know will happen to our earth in the coming years.
I'm going to Congress to support the Harris/Walz Opportunity Economy, which includes $25,000 first time homebuyer assistance, a $50,000 tax credit for new businesses, and a $6,000 first year child tax credit.
I'm going to Congress because we need an immigration bill. It is squarely on the shoulders of Elise Stefanik that we don't have a modern border bill. As Republican Conference Leader, she could have implored her colleagues to introduce and pass a bill. She did not. She would rather complain about the border and blame Kamala Harris than actually do something about the border.
## Stefanik should resign immediately
NY21's current representative cannot act independently. She is so closely aligned with Donald Trump that her focus is on issues that do not improve life for the North Country.
NY21 needs a representative who puts local needs ahead of Trump's needs.
The more we learn about the Jack Smith filing in Judge Chutkan's court, the more it becomes apparent that Trump runs his organizations like a crime syndicate.
Stefanik boasts that she speaks with Trump frequently. Therefore, she knew, or should have known, of the extent of his crimes surrounding the overthrow of the results of the 2020 election.
Her failure to disclose these crimes is a shortfall of ethics, the likes of which we have rarely seen in Congress.
For these reasons, [I am calling upon Elise Stefanik to immediately resign from Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/5f0a80b2-2603-4fa7-9a46-421520e5ffb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and to suspend her campaign for re-election.

# October 21, 2024
---
|
# The Government Has Gone Too Far
---
|
---
| You may have noticed the billboards my campaign has placed throughout Congressional District 18. This one phrase captures why I'm running to represent you in Congress.
When they come after our children, the government has gone too far.
There are so many areas in our lives where the government has overstepped, but I believe the most egregious is with our children.
Having faced many challenges growing up as the child of migrant farm workers, my heart has always gone out to the troubled youth I identified with. In 2014, hoping to make an impact on the lives of these youth, I ran and was elected to the Hollister School Board.
As a father of 4 children, I've seen how easily children can be swayed by the wrong influences. Parents have a huge job in raising their kids to be productive and happy. They certainly don't need government overreach.
Erin Friday, a local attorney and parental rights advocate, was devastated when she was summoned to her daughter's school. Backed up and encouraged by the school counselors, Erin's daughter announced that "she" was now a "he" and this was "his" new name. Erin was devastated but was warned that if she tried to transition her child back, the child would commit suicide.
Because of Erin's experience, and that of countless other parents, I boldly stand for parental rights. My billboards say, "When they come after our children, the government has gone too far." This wording might seem too strong, but when schools secretly transition children and hide that from parents... they have gone too far.
Today Erin is part of Our Duty, a worldwide organization fighting on behalf of parents and children. You can read and join her Substack here: [https://tinyurl.com/OurDutySubstack](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dH4GNPpSUnF1QF-tXEyiapR3GkVU0YzEVpIW4Yx2XK28NtkNOqs71q5IKJZZMUkNjE62oDeC4As9xvBfRyMF3jwULYW94PCYBTf6L98whN_IdSWP_IIiTGWTKgvR-Nq72NxNmvl6Zc8MlAkqsh2DV8aE5vksL_sxCFdvNOwI4uw=&c=46qsXjQWVWYuAGkcoKzxOLAWkzdX9aszsZBUSp4gbthCBMay_766kw==&ch=UlgYQbTjUPv9IfUUX1yocD18WxFEQO_zydhCzoh2VBp2gbZ77D74Uw==).
Although still registered as a Democrat, Erin Friday has endorsed me for Congress and is making clear that Democrats need to support Republican candidates to bring an end to this gender turmoil with our kids.
---
---
| "I support Peter Hernandez. He is pro-family and supports transparency in schools. His adversary, Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, has been in office since 1995. She pretends to care about "our daughters & granddaughters," yet she is an advocate for males who believe that they are women and can enter and participate as females in sports and gain entrance into female-only spaces, and calling Gail Heriot of the US Commission on Civil Rights a "bigot" for believing in biologic reality." Erin Friday, Esq.
---
| We must stand up for children and parental rights, and my opponent will never support that! Thank you for your support. I am proud that activist Democrats like Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh, who ran against Zoe Lofgren in the March Primary Election, and Erin Friday have both endorsed me for Congress.

# Monday, October 21, 2024
---|---

They were posted Friday on Telegram, a messaging app known for its encryption, by a channel that claims to be based in Tehran. # Monday, October 21, 2024
---|---

## Roberson Execution on Hold For Testimony
A Texas House committee will [hear testimony today](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OwyAQhJ8Gd1iACSYFxTXucu2VFj_rZCUMkdmL47c_xf1VI81oRqPv5zbfPGYs92-_gqP3UmcllOZScCXn5DEfs-6SCyJdZQdOjup6EWYUl-7h4qCt9dHoNMrraEM0IYVozGCTuYRoO3SfMSmUlGKQg-ilkRKWZbRepEV7y7SAhFS3nh5A8PZtyUd9wdbHunbZPYiejQ1fTE1MTfu-9zG0Anv75ExNZ4Wp6WMxNW01wEb8lFYLhzfEX8JaeCN_QOIEjXA5eIY7tuwJX8CfvkDmay3JH0xN3ebSc8ecsZmRaXFfPebzDv3L5-XUXwAAAP__kD1rLw) from Robert Roberson, whose execution for the 2002 death of his 2-year-old daughter was halted Thursday after the committee issued him a subpoena for today's hearing. The Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence will [examine a Texas law](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2P8yAQhH-N3RHtAja4oHibdHnbK601LAl3xESGfP37k-_qq0ajkUaPno_TfKKU03r-T1d27RXLLEFqgSAkzoFSfs-6D26BMGHPDo2cBhgNDP3FSbBktIqTCWiinYCRUNGiKCygfeiT288QJCIoVHDAEZFjNJYgRE2208AhtbId2oUbv6jG_C4P3g6-XPvsLq3daqf-dfLYySPdVn7WfdrL1pLP3Mnj5339EjHTk4OoPvHqWfCL_b2lsoqtLLy136hlFXoiJb21IUzDsBhrhoG9MXr0AACR-82F2zPlnOpoOg3nK6X8g9P-9PNw8jsAAP__V35nYw) that authorizes the review of convictions obtained using outdated scientific methods. Roberson was convicted of killing his daughter based on a controversial diagnosis of "shaken baby syndrome." After the committee issued the subpoena, a Travis County judge [ordered a halt to his execution](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOqzAMhZ8mbEGOoUCHDHfJ1rveERnilKiBVEluKW__i3b-F1uyfL5zdP7dxhv54Lf7X1pZl7eLIwK2UoFENVry4RjbyuoJ7FVVrFWP1wt0PVyqRSuy4FomuDhocbpONDcI2HcNNcMEQ-X1CVOASkGjGqhVpxQ71w8E1rU0iBbY-hJTXRYu_KbswhFfnOo5rlXQSynPLJo_Ao1As-97PQc_P3CJ_3OJ2_kl0Gy8Z4EmxJmCQHN6CjQKzjEINB-wtExlkSnu0m8rFZYpTpzKd-W4yd2HIAvn4t0h_Saf3_PELiaWgfaVHpyyXONm6RBoqqTt81T53PWihftKPnySl1-rfGn8CQAA__8R3Xes) last Thursday, just hours before it was scheduled to take place. Attorney General Ken Paxton appealed the ruling, which was then overturned by the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals. Finally, the Texas Supreme Court ordered a stay of the execution at 9:40 p.m. Thursday night. Paxton has asked the court to [reconsider their decision](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OgzAQBOCnMd2itfkLhQsaulx7JXLsJbHiH2SbQN7-lPRXTTHSp9H8Xperss6G-4_yJMu5xkWgaIEjCL4YZd17aSsjb2hGXpHkgxg77AfsqofslRYddmrE9qI77NbR8IGT0gaNpq6prPxgHAXn2PAGa95zTus6XBSatVUX1iIZW2Kqy4MKnSqv7h1flGodfeXko5Qts2ZiYmZiPo6j9jl8OiZmCrBnJuZAxyd0sp6YmJ8UYFNniQFUfmb4qpD3LZEn0HFPBUqERC9KmcCQttnGAIacettwhxRvlHIMQCfpvdgYmJhVgmniefI3qpI022Gds7kfWIt3r6z77i3_HviS4i8AAP__vhF2Lg) and issue a ruling by noon today when Roberson is scheduled to testify.

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T80a06fb4-dea0-4df3-b5d2-e270db28098c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| Peter — I know you’ve been receiving a lot of emails from our team lately, and you deserve an explanation as to why that is. Wisconsin’s Senate race has quickly become the most competitive race in the nation. Multiple election experts have downgraded our race to a “Toss Up” and Eric Hovde just opened up a one-point lead for the very first time in a recent poll. We always knew this was the race that could decide control of the Senate. And Republicans know it too, which is why they’re putting all their chips into Wisconsin. Mitch McConnell’s super PAC launched a last-minute $24 million ad blitz to help my opponent flip this seat red. Eric Hovde himself has even loaned his campaign $20 million from his own personal fortune to defeat me — the largest personal investment of any GOP Senate candidate in the nation. Unlike my opponent, I’ve counted on support from everyday folks to power our work in every election I’ve run in. I’ve been supported by the hard-earned dollars of people across the state who wanted to make a difference. I don’t have the luxury of cutting myself a seven-figure check like my opponent can, but that’s okay — because I have people like you, Peter, who I can count on to chip in what they can, when they can. These emails can be pesky sometimes — believe me, I know. If you knew making a grassroots donation would get rid of one of the worst Donald Trump puppets in the Senate, would ya give?

“What laser”, you say? I’m talkin’ about the best-selling, [Black Ops Tactical Laser Sight](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18845/6374453/efa3b7b1f2cce6606096ceec38a082036a3a5210/b00efa862872f0d5f7e3bcf9afbbf1f60e25665d) by Gunner Gear.
Based on American sniper technology, this ultra-precision laser will speed up your aiming time like **nothing I’ve seen** and can be installed faster than green grass through a goose. What’s even better is with the fire-tempted aluminum framework, it fits practically **any firearm** in my collection. Between you and me, my only regret is not getting one sooner!
For less than 40 USD, I know that these things will be flying off the shelves...
So, you want my two cents? RUN – don’t walk, to grab your [tactical laser sight](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18845/6374453/efa3b7b1f2cce6606096ceec38a082036a3a5210/b00efa862872f0d5f7e3bcf9afbbf1f60e25665d) today.
You’ll thank me later!

subject: When They Come After Our Kids, the Government Has Gone Too Far

BIG Endorsement for Peter Hernandez | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/54404c7c2812/watch-now-electoral-forum-campaign-updates-10347151?e=638e6c2751)

# The Government Has Gone Too Far
---
| You may have noticed the billboards my campaign has placed throughout Congressional District 18. This one phrase captures why I’m running to represent you in Congress.
_**When they come after our children,**__**the government has gone too far.**_
There are so many areas in our lives where the government has overstepped, but I believe the most egregious is with our children.
Having faced many challenges growing up as the child of migrant farm workers, my heart has always gone out to the troubled youth I identified with. In 2014, hoping to make an impact on the lives of these youth, I ran and was elected to the Hollister School Board.
As a father of 4 children, I’ve seen how easily children can be swayed by the wrong influences. Parents have a huge job in raising their kids to be productive and happy. They certainly don’t need government overreach.
Erin Friday, a local attorney and parental rights advocate, was devastated when she was summoned to her daughter’s school. **Backed up and encouraged by the school counselors** , Erin’s daughter announced that “she” was now a “he” and this was “his” new name. Erin was devastated but was warned that if she tried to transition her child back, the child would commit suicide.
Because of Erin’s experience, and that of countless other parents, I boldly stand for parental rights. My billboards say, “When they come after our children, the government has gone too far.” This wording might seem too strong, but **when schools secretly transition children and hide that from parents... they have gone too far.**
Today Erin is part of _Our Duty_ , a worldwide organization fighting on behalf of parents and children. You can read and join her Substack here: [https://tinyurl.com/OurDutySubstack](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=26e57d183c&e=638e6c2751).
Although still registered as a Democrat, Erin Friday has endorsed me for Congress and is making clear that Democrats need to support Republican candidates to bring an end to this gender turmoil with our kids.
---
[](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=bd41180faf&e=638e6c2751)
| _"I support Peter Hernandez. He is pro-family and supports transparency in schools. His adversary, Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, has been in office since 1995. She pretends to care about “ our daughters & granddaughters,” yet she is an advocate for males who believe that they are women and can enter and participate as females in sports and gain entrance into female-only spaces, and calling Gail Heriot of the US Commission on Civil Rights a “bigot” for believing in biologic reality.”_Erin Friday, Esq.
---
| We must stand up for children and parental rights, and my opponent will never support that! Thank you for your support.
I am proud that activist Democrats like Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh, who ran against Zoe Lofgren in the March Primary Election, and Erin Friday have both endorsed me for Congress.
---
| Regards,Peter Hernandez

Peter, This is it! We’re just two weeks away from making history and we need to make sure that voters everywhere know that they have the choice to vote for people, planet and peace with Jill and Butch. As we go into these last two weeks, we’re in awe of how far this campaign has come with the support of people like you. We’ve taken on empire and the empire has tried to stop us at every turn. From lawfare intended to kick us off the ballot, to delaying earned federal matching funds at a crucial moment of our ballot access efforts, to siccing their attack dogs like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Angela Rye, and Mehdi Hasan on us, and even putting out a national ad designed to bully the people out of making the most empowering choice of Stein/Ware – but for all their money and power they not only haven’t been able to stop us, but instead this movement has only grown by leaps and bounds every day.

Now is the time to make sure we can get out the vote. Because of your amazing support, we’ve been able to create three powerful ads. We need to make sure voters everywhere can see them. Have you seen our latest ad? Please watch [“Forget the lesser evil, vote for the greater good” ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/greatergood?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_21_am&n=1)here.

We’re also going to launch digital billboards in key cities, and with your help, these billboards should reach 8 million voters before the election! Can you give whatever you can, whether it’s $2.40, $24.00 or more to help us amplify these ads in these crucial final weeks?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/greatergood?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_21_am&n=2)

If you’ll let me, I want to make my case for why **[we could really use your help in Nevada today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95471497/506834363/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5156-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGFlOTIxMC1hZDhmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6mhWcjk7vBfHOseaad1c5Zs3wcKuFJh_SJrH42UGNvA=)**

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2103%2E135344%2Epa-Ymh)

Friends --
We made a very difficult decision last week.
We had a Team Slotkin meeting where it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could make a real play for additional votes as voting was underway across the state.
The money wasn’t in the budget. But I gave the green light.
It’s a risk. But this is the moment to take some risks. I’ve had similar moments in prior years. We can’t get caught short when people are already casting their ballots in this election. That'd be a mistake.
But the bet we made was that, as the race tightens, and if we asked, our supporters would come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will. To keep the Senate in the hands of the Democrats.
So with that in mind: [**can you make a $3 contribution to help us fill the budget gap we created going after the voters we need to persuade to help win this race? $3 isn’t much, but at this point it’s the small-dollar donations that are making a difference here at the end.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241021-1-900&t=2&akid=2103%2E135344%2Epa-Ymh)
Like I said, it was a tough call. But if there’s one thing that distinguishes this campaign from every other, it’s our people. You answer the call every single time. $3 is all we need to close the gap.

subject: Just poured myself a cup — can we check in?

body:
I'll be honest:
| | |
---
Good morning, friend — I just poured myself a cup of coffee and am eager to write to you and get my day going! 🌞
I'll be honest: I need a lot of coffee these days, and it's because I'm not sleeping much. Everything is OK, it's just that I'm a bundle of nerves and excitement in these final days of the campaign, where we are _so close_ to actually defeating Rick Scott and protecting Democratic control of the Senate!
I need you to know that we never would have gotten to this point without you. We never would have gotten to a point where the **_polls are tied_** , where _**Rick Scott is forced to spend**_ tens of millions of dollars to compete with our grassroots movement, where the **_major Democratic committees_** spend millions of dollars of their own money to help us because they believe in us!
Thank you, friend. A year ago at this time, the political pundits wrote off Florida completely. We put Florida in play. We gave Rick Scott his notice. We are on the cusp of pulling off the greatest political upset in modern history.
**But Rick Scott is outspending me nearly 3-to-1 on the airwaves — and he's already spent over $37 million on ads to defeat me. Well, I don't have a fraudulently earned fortune like him to tap into. I have you, friend. I have this grassroots movement. And I can only fight back and win by closing in on my daily $500,000 goal at midnight tonight. **
**[So please, will you make a donation of $5 or more to help me make history here in Florida? Whatever you give will be put to work immediately to counter Rick Scott's attack ads, defeat him once and for all, and save our Democratic Senate majority!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95480072/506858881/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2305-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWQ1NDM1YWEtYjI4Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YChiugGZ3_2fYD40ZFkbJMvngXrAxL0dX-YS8dC_t4Y=)**

Friends,
It's clear that the network of dark money billionaires and election deniers are targeting the work we are doing in Michigan.
When I called Elon Musk out, he made it personal. Attacking me directly - all while pumping tens of millions of dollars into efforts to subvert our democratic process.
There’s only one response to misinformation and the democracy deniers who push it:
Tell the truth. Far and wide.

https://x.com/JocelynBenson/status/1848114593807364110 [https://x.com/JocelynBenson/status/1848114593807364110]

Every member of my team is hard at work making sure the truth about our elections and our electoral process in Michigan is told.
In Michigan, we tell the truth and follow the law. In Michigan, we keep making history with the most secure and transparent elections in America. In Michigan, we're making sure that every eligible citizen has the chance to make their voices heard - resulting in the best youth turnout in the country last cycle.

And we’re all inspired by you - the people reading this - because time and time again, when we’ve put out the call for Democracy Defenders to help push back against the misinformation and help us tell the truth, you’ve delivered.

It’s why I’m proud to have launched the Democracy Defenders program right here in Michigan, and why so many of you raising their hands and saying “I’m on Team Democracy” means so much.
So when a dark money billionaire sets his sights on Michigan and the work we’re doing, we’re ready to stand up and fight back.
Here’s what I’m asking you today: Watch my response to Elon Musk and his attacks. Go to Michigan.gov/electionfacts [http://michigan.gov/electionfacts] . And please spread the word. Forward this to one person you think needs to hear it.

Defending democracy is what you elected me to do - and it’s what each of us need to make the choice to stand up and do every day in the face of these attacks.
I'm never going to apologize for defending our democracy. And I'm certainly not going to apologize for doing my duty or for doing the job the voters of Michigan overwhelmingly sent me to do.
If you're with me, please help spread the word today and help amplify our powerful message >> [https://x.com/JocelynBenson/status/1848114593807364110]

Together,
Jocelyn

name: community@uso.org
subject: With so much going on in the world, service members need your support more than ever.
body:
Your generosity keeps our critical programs and services going.
We know this is an incredibly busy time, but we want to remind you of a few things:
Amid all the political ads and election noise, _hundreds of thousands of U.S. service members_ are stationed all over the world, selflessly serving our country and providing help to those in need.
The USO is there for people who serve and their families through every step of their military journey, but we are not a government entity; we're a nonprofit organization funded by generous donations from caring supporters like you.
**[We need your help to continue delivering the programs and services our heroes rely on. So please, will you give $29 or more today to show your support?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/b9ZASry_~KM8/a3pZUE5LNnZPQlJ6SlRFWWVwMEJlVG5jS3YwdGk2S3VwK21wQVVGQW1MQmtEaVk3UzEzVkttOEtoOTQ5RmkyQkZ4eXJlQy9yeElPRGYyNDN2VDJzT09ERVErdkNtQk1SbXZIak5KMnJYQ2M9S0/UE1YSDhQTnRJSnp1cFQ3dW9UQjFZcnVSVVVZNExneE5MZHhadzVqcFFHdlZiaHdGVmdWZjNvd2ZQT2VEOVVHVE9BSnV6SEdyYlVBZjBlQVFvSnk4L3A2Um10NzVCZ1ZRS0)**

Thank you,
The USO
* * *

**Sent: **Sunday, October 20, 2024
**Subject:** This is not a political email
[](https://www.uso.org)

In times of uncertainty, it's easy to feel overwhelmed by the noise and distractions around us. This year, as the nation's focus is on the election, we are reminded that while much may change, one thing remains steadfast: the unwavering dedication, courage and commitment of our service members.
Whatever is happening in our nation, they continue to stand guard or provide assistance in emergency situations, often far from home and family, embodying the very best of what it means to serve.
And at the USO, we strive to be a source of consistency for the men and women who serve and sacrifice, offering comfort and connection when they need it most. Your support helps us send care packages filled with essentials and reminders of home, bridging the gap between the battlefield and the familiar comforts of everyday life.
**Today, we invite you to take a moment, away from the debates and discussions, to make a tangible difference.**
**[Please donate $29 or more to help show our service members that, no matter what, they are not forgotten and their sacrifices are deeply appreciated.](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/4NKwHKZY~)**

---

WITH THEIR CHILDREN FOR BEDTIME STORIES*](https://links.e.uso.)
---

Thank you for being a constant in their lives, even in a world of change.
--The USO

**When I ran for Congress, I told people I 'd do something different in Washington: I'd speak the truth.** It is only by speaking the truth that we can have leaders we trust, in charge of a government we trust. I've always spoken the truth, I am speaking the truth now, and I will continue to speak the truth, no matter the cost. Our nation deserves nothing less.

My vision for the 10th District is rooted in the values that have made America great - freedom, hard work, and integrity. In Congress, I'll fight to cut through the red tape that holds our businesses back, secure our borders to protect our communities, and ensure our veterans receive the care they deserve. It's time to take back our country and make sure North Carolina leads the way.

For too long, our government has stood in the way of American success, both at home and abroad. When America fails to lead, the consequences are felt worldwide. As your next Congressman, my mission will be clear: We will not engage in wars we shouldn't fight, but when we do, we will ensure our troops have the support and what they need to win decisively and in the cheapest way possible.

This commitment may seem straightforward, but recent years have shown just how far we've strayed from it. Our next generation deserves to inherit an America that is strong, respected, and secure. Achieving that starts with us--and it starts now.

One thing I learned as a Green Beret Commander and as a business owner is that **real leadership means listening to those you serve.** Too many politicians today are out of touch with hard working Americans, ignoring the voices that matter most.

That's why I entered politics--to be a voice for the middle class, for entrepreneurs chasing their dreams, and for a prosperous and safe future for our children. As your Congressman, I promise to listen, advocate for policies that strengthen our economy, and fight for the prosperous, secure future our next generation deserves.

#

**July 21, 2024**
That was three months ago today. That date may not ring a bell right off the bat, but that was the day Vice President Kamala Harris launched her campaign for president after President Biden’s decision to exit the race.
We have been so proud to stand with Vice President Harris since her campaign launch. We know that she is ready to serve as our next president, and that she will be a steadfast partner in our gun violence prevention movement.
It’s been an extremely busy few months since this historic day for our nation. These are undoubtedly unprecedented times, and we’re grateful to have had you with us every step of the way.
**November 5, 2024**
That’s Election Day, which believe it or not, is just **_fifteen_** days from today. These last fifteen days are absolutely critical. We don’t have much time left now to ensure that we are getting out the vote for not only the Harris-Walz ticket, but for the over 300 other gun safety champions we have endorsed up and down the ballot.

subject: please don't make us choose:
body:
With just about two weeks until Election Day, we're finalizing our spending decisions, and we're doing it while we're short of our budget goals.
---
Derek -- We are just about two weeks away from Election Day. We're finalizing our spending decisions, and we're doing it while we're short of our budget goals. It's not ideal, but it is where we're at. Like any good organization, every state and every race we're targeting has a budget. If we meet our goals, everything gets fully funded and Democrats have a great chance to win. If we don't meet our budget goals, we have to start deciding what states and races to pull money out of. In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

Friend -- Would you like to change the course of world history this week? Would you like to know why, and how, you can do that? Join us for tonight’s Vega-Sare meeting, along with political commentator and journalist Garland Nixon and US Air Force former Command Chief Master Sergeant Dennis Fritz, National Director of the Eisenhower Media Network. First, we are just days away from Saturday, October 26, and our concert/conference “Build A Chorus of Peace Against the Ghouls of War.” The message: a chorus of voices raised for peace and justice is more powerful than a handful of voices for war. This will be a unique event, unlike anything you have ever attended. We need you there, in the audience! We need your help to let people know about the event, and about supporting our efforts financially, as well as with your and others’ presence. There’s still time to get tickets, give money, and spread the word! (See announcement below.) Second, the meeting of the BRICS-Plus nations—Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, plus another 50-plus countries—begins tomorrow in Russia—directly opposite this week’s Washington meeting of the 190-nation International Monetary Fund. The dying imperial order on the one hand, the emerging, productive nations of the “Global South” representing the majority of the human race, 6 billion people-plus, on the other. In this setting, the economic policies of LaRouche Independents Diane Sare and Jose Vega can be center stage, and in both gatherings. But how—and what does that have to do with you? Get on the call tonight and find out!! | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/sare_vega_and_friends_20241021?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241021_monday_zoom&n=2 "RSVP for Sare-Vega Zoom Link for Tonight 8:30

Third, the elections _aren’t_ two weeks away—people are voting now! That means that we need many of you doing things to help get out posters, signs, palm, cards, and where possible, with poll-watching. Diane will detail this tonight, so join us to hear what you can do, wherever you are, in these final days before November 5.
You are more powerful than you think, and you are more capable than you realize. The War Party knows this, and hopes we stay asleep. By lifting our voices we can change a world that is already being dramatically changed, forever, this week. Why miss the fun?

Somebody who was raised in the middle class; who worked a summer job at McDonald’s while she earned a degree; who believes in the values that built this country. Somebody who has served with distinction in every office that she has ever held. _Kamala is as prepared for the job as any nominee for president has ever been._ Now it’s up to all of us to join her in the fight for the America we believe in. clean_body: It’s up to all of us to join Kamala Harris and Tim Walz in the fight for the America we believe in. Let’s get to work. | | | Peter, there is no time to waste. We have 15 days until Election Day, and folks are already voting to choose our next president. We have a chance to elect someone who has spent her life fighting on behalf of people who need a voice and a chance. Somebody who was raised in the middle class; who worked a summer job at McDonald’s while she earned a degree; who believes in the values that built this country. Somebody who has served with distinction in every office that she has ever held. Kamala is as prepared for the job as any nominee for president has ever been. Now it’s up to all of us to join her in the fight for the America we believe in. And make no mistake: it will be a fight. For all the incredible energy we’ve been able to generate over the last few months, this will still be a tight race. ** | | The people who haven’t made up their minds yet about who they’re voting for or whether to vote -- here’s what I know about them: They want to hear from you. The truth is, Peter, the most powerful voice in any election is yours. Neighbors talking to neighbors -- that’s how our politics is supposed to work. That’s how we win. Ordinary people sharing their hopes, their dreams, their reasons for voting -- maybe with a close friend or relative, maybe with a perfect stranger -- and being reminded once again that we all have a stake in one another. So, I am counting on you, Peter. The work we do right now will determine the outcome on November 5. Let’s get to work, Barack Barack Obama | | | |

| MassGOP Endorses Legislation to Restore Court Authority to Honor ICE Detainers
---
---
| Boston, MA- The Massachusetts Republican Party fully supports and commends the latest legislation introduced by Senate Minority Leader Bruce Tarr, House Minority Leader Brad Jones, and the Republican caucus.
Recent reports have revealed cases of illegal immigrants sexually assaulting minors. In several instances, ICE had issued detainers for the perpetrators. However, due to statutory gaps, these individuals could not be held or transferred to federal authorities. Instead, they were released back into the community, posing a continued threat to public safety.
This critical legislation seeks to authorize courts to honor ICE detainers--a power eliminated by the 2017 Lunn v. Commonwealth decision. That ruling barred state court officers from detaining individuals solely on ICE requests, resulting in dangerous offenders--some who have already been convicted of serious crimes--being released with the potential to reoffend. The proposed measure reinstates the ability of court officials to work with immigration authorities, preventing high-risk individuals from evading accountability.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale emphasized the urgency of this legislation, stating:"In what other country can an illegal immigrant, charged with aggravated rape of a child, be arraigned and set free on bail without coordination with immigration authorities? This policy endangers public safety, and every day the legislature delays action further threatens our communities."
Carnevale concluded with a call to action: "I commend the Republican caucus for introducing this essential legislation. Now the full legislature must act to empower courts to honor ICE detainers, safeguard our communities, and do what's right for the people of Massachusetts. This is not a partisan issue--it's about protecting public safety."
The MassGOP urges the legislature to pass this bill without delay to ensure justice is served and to prevent further harm to Massachusetts residents.

these issues.

country.

#

Peter — I’m at a bit of a loss.
I’m wracking my brain trying to figure out why we can’t hit our goals, and what I can do or say to turn that around.
I’m only trying to raise what I need to defeat Kari Lake, but my campaign has made deep cuts over the last few weeks because we’ve fallen short of just about every single daily fundraising goal that we’ve set.
At this point, we’re cutting to the bone. Every day comes with another tough choice: do we divert resources here, do we try to make due with less there, do we double down and hope this turns around... and these aren’t the kind of decisions you want to be making late in the race.
You want to be on the offense. You want to be aggressive, because that’s what it’s going to take to defeat Kari Lake. I’m hoping there’s still a chance that we can get back on the right foot, and fast, because our window to reach the voters we need is closing.
So, look. I’m not asking for much. I know what it means to work hard for every dollar you earn. And I hope you never feel like you need to give anything more than you can afford.
[**But if you can, I’m asking you to chip in $5. If you can do more than that, it’s absolutely welcome. But $5 is all I’m asking for. No matter whether you own property or not, eliminating the property tax will benefit all North Dakotans... | | | | | |
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=505d87c8d4&e=d842fb25cc)
| | | | | Peter,

We are just 15 days away from Election Day, and the stakes have never been higher...

The opposition has raised nearly $2 million — over ten times what we’ve managed to gather — because lobbyists and special interest groups are banding together to protect their gravy train.

**Their strategy is simple** : flood the airwaves and print media with a well-funded campaign of fear and lies, hoping to deceive you into voting no on Measure 4.

They know that if they fool you into voting against it, they can continue to profit from the money our state showers them with.

**Shockingly, less than 1% of their contributions come from regular North Dakotans like you and me!**

Over 99% of their funding comes from lobbyists and special interest political action committees. And, to add insult to injury, the ironically named "Keep It Local" group has received over $1 MILLION from out-of-state lobbying groups!

In comparison, **we are 100% funded by hardworking North Dakotans** like you who are tired of wasteful spending and broken promises. We’ve had enough of property tax increases and lobbyists lining their pockets with our money.
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=e07e8b83f3&e=d842fb25cc)
| **Now, we need your help more than ever. Every dollar you contribute helps us reach more voters!

**[**Donate $20.24 >>>
Sponsor a Radio Ad - $50 >>>
Sponsor a Digital Ad - $100 >>>
Sponsor Two Newspaper Ads - $250 >>>
Sponsor One Day of Billboard Advertising - $500 >>>
Donate any amount to end North Dakota’s property tax >>>**](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=15c198ecd2&e=d842fb25cc)
No matter whether you own property or not, eliminating the property tax will benefit all North Dakotans.

This is a true David vs. Goliath battle, and we can’t do it without your support.

Have you had enough? If so, **vote YES on Measure 4**!

Let’s take control away from the special interest lobbyists and give it back to where it belongs: cities, counties, schools... and YOU!

[Can we count on your support?](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=77339e10de&e=d842fb25cc)

name: Neil Parrott
subject: New poll-we're up 4, & See Steve Moore TOMORROW!
body:
We're up in the polls and an important fundraiser with economist Steve Moore is happening tomorrow! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=69614db72d)
---
|
---
| | Peter,

**Our latest polling shows that we are leading my Democratic opponent, April McClain-Delaney, by 4 points!** This is a massive momentum shift, and it’s clear that voters are responding to our message of real solutions for Maryland’s 6th District.

While my opponent is out of state fundraising with the likes of Hillary Clinton, we remain focused on what matters most—delivering results for the working people here in Montgomery, Frederick, Washington, Allegany and Garrett counties.

Recent poll results:

• 45% support for our campaign
• 41% for my opponent
• 14% undecided

We’re gaining traction in key voter groups, including independents and young voters, and it’s clear that Marylanders want a representative who will stand up for them and slash inflation, lower the price of groceries, end illegal immigration, and secure the border. We simply cannot afford more of the same Biden-Harris-Delaney agenda.

**But the fight is far from over. We need to keep up the momentum all the way through Election Day, and that’s WHERE YOU COME IN.**

---
| [Please Send What You Can to Help Us Reach Voters](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=b6376016c8&e=5a45ee1154 "Please Send What You Can to Help Us Reach Voters")
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=817d0fad0e&e=5a45ee1154 "CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD")
---
|
---
| Join Me This Monday

I’m inviting you to a special event hosted by legendary economist and writer Steve Moore, along with his wife Anne, on Monday, October 21st, at 6:00 PM in Potomac, MD. This is a chance to come together, discuss our path to victory, and hear directly from me about how we’re going to win this race, and what we can do to bring back fiscal sanity and responsible economic policy back to DC. Plus, if you have ever had the opportunity to hear Steve Moore talk, you know that he is just a powerhouse of information!

**Address will be provided when you RSVP**
**Please email contact@neilparrott.org for details!**
**Time: 6:00 PM**

Please RSVP at one of the sponsorship levels if you would like to attend—April and I would love to see you there!
---
| [SEND ANYTHING YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN!](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=bbf9f48f65&e=5a45ee1154 "SEND ANYTHING YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN!")
---
| **The entire House leadership just endorsed me. Jim Jordan, Elise Stefanik, Tom Emmer, Steve Scalise and Speaker Mike Johnson have all personally given me their endorsement and encouragement.** They know we're so close to winning this thing.

**We'll need YOU to help put us over the top though. If you want to volunteer, please email contact@neilparrott.org right away.** We'll get you to work down the stretch! Without your help we can't win. You don't have to live in the district, either, you can make phone calls from anywhere, and we can set it all up for you!

For Our Country,
Neil Parrott

Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q. Is a policy of income redistribution needed to lessen the gap between the wealthy and working classes? A. I strongly disagree with such a policy. Individuals should be responsible for their own welfare and the welfare of their families. In cases where an individual cannot care for themselves, then the family, extended family, and community should help. Americans should be allowed to enjoy the benefits of their labor. We should not take from someone who works hard and give it to someone else who doesn't work as hard. If someone has spent time developing skills and talents, we shouldn't take from them to give to someone else who hasn't. Q. Should the government cut spending in order to reduce the national debt? A. Friend — by now, with just 15 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important.
But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to **[make your very first online donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95493848/506899541/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2291-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGJjZjMzYTEtYzA4Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fjf1HaQDSnG11LYEkKNQs1cQk2wUBvus9zSnVoq1XOE=)** before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott!
First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life.

Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much.
After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs**.

Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year.

During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country.

Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage** , worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief** to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration**.
I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead.

**As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 15 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process.**
**[But with Rick Scott outspending me 3-1 on the airwaves, it's going to take a surge in grassroots support from people like you to truly defeat him. clean_body: I'm putting my record up against Rick Scott's | | | Friend — by now, with just 15 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important. But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to = before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott! First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much. After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year. During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to expand affordable health care access to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage , worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for Everglades restoration. I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead. As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 15 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. body:
Voting began two weeks ago, and I have some mixed news to share.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BSULvfCaAd2Ve9w8XZKqoe2S3ZkIOR1nPAC-EhPg5_5n3ArQjmHTwSdpG-1cm8AE4s&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=early_returns&n=1)

---
Friend, Voting began two weeks ago, and I have some mixed news to share. The good: 25% of all returned ballots are from Republican voters, even though we make up only 20% of the electorate. The not so good: Democrats have returned more ballots than Republicans. **We must narrow the gap ASAP** , and you can help by contributing to our [Chase The Ballots](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BSULvfCaAd2Ve9w8XZKqoe2S3ZkIOR1nPAC-EhPg5_5n3ArQjmHTwSdpG-1cm8AE4s&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=early_returns&n=2) operation. We’re going door-to-door, calling voters, and hosting community events between now and Election Day to ensure as many Republicans as possible vote early. | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only __**15 days**__ until Election Day! Where has the time gone?! We had an incredible week at Kean for Congress, and I am excited to share some fantastic updates below. Thousands more vote-by-mail (VBM) ballots have been returned, and the Early Voting period begins this __**Saturday, October 26th**__. Make sure that you have a plan to vote! Every vote will matter in this close race. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain this outstanding momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. This past week, Tom and our campaign team, attended in-district events, focused on growing our war chest to keep our ads on air, door knocked and phone banked. Thanks to your help, we once again out-walked and out-called our opponent's team - __**the 4th week in a row**__! The efforts we make as a team to close out these last two weeks will be vital to a successful November 5th. Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. This week coming, we will focus on running parallel tracks between VBM chase efforts and pushing our target universes to Early Vote! We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and again increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. This week, our comms team launched two new broadcast commercials, highlighted our opponent's [flip-flop on supporting Israel](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e1f67f70696046f49cedab40e3d4fd48&_e=F4S30xloKV3k3ZH-CNrHqKfl8agk9kOcyDi9CMvYYgbLK8j9Yd7xZ_9FS7T3xTKiunESW-PmsGr6MJe1awB4tjvozcTvrZyTwTEsW6L4p-ZPkvQ0BlTc4V5ye9GsAvv0O9hZzPkIr6FLvAYm7F4C2hnDO7xdez0vJnH0VUvqomxxqtAoPd6gdcNs8R6dC3lbse5iifVi-KaYqy-CyQjpAkzhyV5A1gKwdVxzjZYEJA6KQnR0qYTPIiRK1F9qMMAhHeLo_9bnRzZF4M9CvZye11zNEVG1SurKXg_QyeWBW_ft6CEyhzo1dsC5TBZ1V8fmaFko1AfKPcKglVCSNzlFOgrIrE_Aa9SefpMrFGcGBiFOzrBWmG-76FJAfgJPxzi21JLkhz0u_KqAcc8siae0iMLwl1OkGPeDXLj33ZOLFdvyvzv_zMdlAnj9x6mLF6zUC97i1v2Nf3f38Ruhtr8D2mQjrJ79ABQO_xZ84elCAF3pmKIaJTmlLZLXb7GwKz5V), and called out her plans to [decriminalize all narcotics](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=e1f67f70696046f49cedab40e3d4fd48&_e=F4S30xloKV3k3ZH-CNrHqKfl8agk9kOcyDi9CMvYYgbLK8j9Yd7xZ_9FS7T3xTKiunESW-PmsGr6MJe1awB4tuCsKAf1WBKpc-5devwd3kpuefzT4C-tGj1xeVSnDntS_uYXRyuGgfYgb4cG_vbvRXgEX--bObyEv4duhK5sMw-TaKWaEZ97j7W7dwejbyqwx8RBf_5ykIk_QMLsH7ZiR3aL2HHOVhSe0XsuH2c4sLqE4lT3BEYBX0Tdm7NYF5GvHomcYacwPBfYdun3MH3Vg2pRsulOuB4JHImcWhObLKPXAZs4b7_XaixXQc5SXdBvBGwkYvO6-0LXhomV7zBpqG3aog99PZ92dd24a1lfumoApWda0HsWYBKXStCcFd3GpQUFk2JyDMFHxiAezhdz5Vggqzh-x9j9KofvEW_8tUvspiTU0BSCM0MVip4CaJ5ejUoPeUfdmp5Kwq-WUZkQ-paOlQVG938weLrJ7yDcElbJKHqTIWl3WzxIFBoCtaZ3XGADlDRZ045s5dJhgs4dryHHmvAOVIx9v3aTfQDOQzs%3D). Follow us on social media so you don't miss out on any updates from our comms team! If you choose, you can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. If you do, please _ make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th_. Early in-person voting begins across all six counties this Saturday, October 26th at 10am. To find an early voting location, open times, and more information, please read the rest of the email. This year, I will be banking my vote for Tom at the early voting site nearest to me in Hunterdon County - it is an easy and effective system. | | This past week, Kean for Congress released its newest ad, "A Father." The ad features Westfield resident Dorota Mani, a mother who found out her daughter and other students fell victim to deep-fake and explicit AI-generated images which had been shared by other students at school.
The horrific incident sparked international headlines over the dangers of unchecked AI technology. In response to the incident, the Mani family partnered with Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. to help introduce and advocate for the AI Labeling Act.
_“As a father, I am deeply disturbed by how effortlessly this technology can be used in an explicit nature and minors can easily be the victims. We live in a highly advanced world that is ever-changing. We must do everything we can to stop non consensual deep fakes online, and also ensure that there are legal repercussions for these bad actors.” _\- _**Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**_ **⬇️** _**WATCH THE AD**_**⬇️**

If you or anyone you know is interested in stepping up to assist, please use the volunteer sign up link below to join the team.
