clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only 15 days until Election Day! Where has the time gone?! We had an incredible week at Kean for Congress, and I am excited to share some fantastic updates below. Thousands more vote-by-mail (VBM) ballots have been returned, and the Early Voting period begins this Saturday, October 26th. Make sure that you have a plan to vote! Every vote will matter in this close race. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs so we can maintain this outstanding momentum, break further ahead, and run up the score before Election Day. This past week, Tom and our campaign team, attended in-district events, focused on growing our war chest to keep our ads on air, door knocked and phone banked. Thanks to your help, we once again out-walked and out-called our opponent's team - the 4th week in a row! The efforts we make as a team to close out these last two weeks will be vital to a successful November 5th. Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. This week coming, we will focus on running parallel tracks between VBM chase efforts and pushing our target universes to Early Vote! We hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and again increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. This week, our comms team launched two new broadcast commercials, highlighted our opponent's , and called out her plans to . Follow us on social media so you don't miss out on any updates from our comms team! If you choose, you can still request a vote-by-mail ballot if you would like until October 29th. If you do, please make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th. Early in-person voting begins across all six counties this Saturday, October 26th at 10am. To find an early voting location, open times, and more information, please read the rest of the email. This year, I will be banking my vote for Tom at the early voting site nearest to me in Hunterdon County - it is an easy and effective system. You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our . Questions? . Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: Lawn signs are moving fast, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | 📺 Kean for Congress Releases New Ad: "A Father" 📺 | | This past week, Kean for Congress released its newest ad, "A Father." The ad features Westfield resident Dorota Mani, a mother who found out her daughter and other students fell victim to deep-fake and explicit AI-generated images which had been shared by other students at school. The horrific incident sparked international headlines over the dangers of unchecked AI technology. In response to the incident, the Mani family partnered with Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. to help introduce and advocate for the AI Labeling Act. “As a father, I am deeply disturbed by how effortlessly this technology can be used in an explicit nature and minors can easily be the victims. We live in a highly advanced world that is ever-changing. We must do everything we can to stop non consensual deep fakes online, and also ensure that there are legal repercussions for these bad actors.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. ⬇️ WATCH THE AD⬇️ | | | | 📺 Kean for Congress Releases New Ad: "Radical Sue" 📺 | | Kean for Congress also released a new ad, "Radical Sue." The ad highlights Sue Altman’s history as the leader of the progressive New Jersey Working Families Party, her support for increased government spending, increased taxes and decriminalized narcotics, and her work to defund the police. “Sue Altman’s extreme agenda is dangerous for New Jersey families. She has shown time and again that her priorities are out of touch with the values of the 7th District. While she fights for the fringes of her party, I am fighting for all of our constituents and communities.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. ⬇️ WATCH THE AD⬇️ | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | The Field Team is operating in overdrive! The spent the week scheduling out the remaining door launches before GOTV weekend and activated volunteers. They built out walk lists for our local teams, and also prepared significant resources for the multiple labor walks we have heading into the weekend. If you or anyone you know is interested in stepping up to assist, please use the volunteer sign up link below to join the team. Our door knocking program covered towns like Clinton Town , Flemington , Raritan Township , Readington , High Bridge , West Amwell , Tewksbury , Long Hill , Springfield , Berkeley Heights , the Mendhams , Rahway , Summit , Hopatcong , Sparta , Stanhope , Green , Washington Borough , Pohatcong , Lopatcong , Alpha , Greenwich , Byram , Warren Township , Green Brook , Bridgewater , Bernards , Bernardsville , Branchburg , and Raritan Borough! Our weekly door goal is once again increasing significantly next week, and we must make sure we are doing everything we can to reach the voters we need to with two weeks left. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with five organized phone banks this week in Union, Hunterdon, Warren and Somerset counties. This week we were able to call over 17,000 voters across all six counties. We also sent out over 83,000 text messages. We have a minimum of two to three phone banks a week that you can join from now until Election Day! Our county organizations will continue their vote-by-mail chase efforts on phones this week, as well as starting our Early Vote push. Looking for an easy way to get involved? Join our texting team to help put up points on the board. Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. name: River Gassen
subject: 15 Days to Go—We’re on the Verge of Making History!
body:
With just 15 days left until Election Day, our campaign is surging. We’re feeling the energy, the momentum, and the excitement building - | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/15daysremaining-8329955?e=3818d77efc)
---
|
# 15 Days to Go—We’re on the Verge of Making History!
---
|
With just 15 days left until Election Day, our campaign is surging. We’re feeling the energy, the momentum, and the excitement building—but we’re not done yet. We have the potential to make history, and I truly believe that with your help, we can bring home a win for our community.
I’ve been talking to voters, knocking on doors, and feeling the incredible support from people who are ready for change. But we can’t afford to slow down now. We need one last push to get our message out to every undecided voter in these final days—and for that, I’m asking for your help.
It’s not too late to make a difference. Your donation today will help us:
* Reach voters with targeted digital ads and reminders to turn in their ballots.

* Mobilize volunteers to knock on doors and make calls.

* Keep our momentum going strong through Election Day.

Every dollar counts in these final two weeks. Can you donate $5, $10, or whatever you can today to help us cross the finish line?
I know we have what it takes to win this. We’ve come this far, and I’m more hopeful than ever that, together, we can create the change our community deserves. But I can’t do it without you.
Let’s make these final days count—it’s not too late to donate and be part of history in the making.
Thank you for standing with me every step of the way.

In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5
P.S. **15 days** isn’t a lot of time, but it’s enough to make all the difference. If you believe in the potential of this campaign like I do, please donate today and help us finish strong!
---
[Donate Now](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=943dd54f45&e=3818d77efc)
|
If you're unable to donate, I know how you feel - I’m spent too, every dollar I have to spare is going towards democracy.

We could still use your help! We have 5 Get out the Vote Events coming up, with today’s being in Fountain. We also have blocks that still need lit to be dropped.
If you’re interested, text our volunteer coordinator - 303.601.1821. Give her your name, availability, and rather or not you would like need an in-person tutorial on mini Van (the application we use to collect the data of which voters have been contacted).

undermine the Supreme Court...

Patriot,

unborn. And today I need your help.

I know
you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to
overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement
will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won.

Nothing
could be further from the truth-the fight for life is only just
beginning!

Right
now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the
Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice
democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at

allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority
of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that
abortion should be unrestricted.

We must
stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we
don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will
continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to
advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of
the American family.

Today,
I'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe

everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the
spread of the Left's anti-life ideology. Will you take a minute
to stand with me by signing this pledge now?

I'd like
to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can

Dr. Ben

We’re closing the gap, fellow patriot.

From day one, we’ve heard from the naysayers that the polling wasn’t on our side. But now, with less than two weeks left, we’ve not just closed the gap, we’re leading by just one point.

Fellow patriot, but here’s the bad news. We’re still in the margin of error. That means this is anyone’s race.

**And Sherrod Brown just closed out a $30+ million fundraising quarter.**

He literally has tens of thousands of millions to spend to attack me in the most critical time of this race.

[**Can I count on you to help me fight back against this onslaught of attacks -_especially now that this race is so close?_**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6925ccd846e240dfa147f2142d4a82c5&_e=KI5DPdSfomMarUv0lLdH5PYSq8jDOqZ2qI53qLhDW8qHYc-ViQ7e8FVdOEcJ1qTXwuUGNopEpL0DL1lUAzmN7Lh24Rr2I9-g8vcHjbN0oDl-8-IGHVC9xQlteRO3HQkfK40riysKbxlwxAK22D6piN1iQG4gcDRoEBfvT7MkXaAomD9F01Z8mtWNZueEG_AVZ28olh0HgoTQ2nW-JaYIK-pgHMcbm4oAX-prHWwXhRkZV0XQTIi0TVPEz34PNCAmnzO6MsvmpCDd8g2sqSsmyw3FE3V5KNA_BGX9GFXRUzKAYGzezGjDrpPbEDuk9Cr4z8h5Csu7LVJkzNSp8SXA5KfoG6458RkOekfOaoN873MZg3Lv3ptwsbdI3PyCgrWsnoZTguzqm-udCP8yI35-Drs6fE5GJ3E3rv0Jii8JV6W7F09teIEI1qbWVHTlrUD1)

Friend,

I want to tell you why I’m inspired by Dan Osborn, an industrial mechanic running to be Nebraska’s next senator.

But first, I need your help. Dan is under attack from Mitch McConnell and right-wing billionaire-funded super PACs. They know he could be the deciding vote in the US Senate. We can’t let them do it.

Can you rush a contribution to Dan’s campaign right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241021-lift-2]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241021-lift-2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241021-lift-2]

Dan Osborn knows what it’s like to work for a living. A Navy and Nebraska National Guard veteran, he put his college education on hold and took a job as an industrial mechanic at the Kellogg’s plant in Omaha to support his family. He worked 50-, 60-, and sometimes 90-hour weeks. During his last year at the factory, he picked up 33 different 16-hour shifts on Sundays to give his family a better life.

Dan was elected president of his union, BCTGM Local 50G. He successfully led a 77-day strike in 2021 at the Omaha Kellogg’s plant, securing 500 jobs and worker benefits. Kellogg’s retaliated by firing Osborn for leading the strike.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241021-lift-2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241021-lift-2]

FiveThirtyEight is calling this the closest Senate race in the country. Five brand-new polls show Dan is narrowly leading his Republican opponent, Deb Fischer, and Republicans are getting scared. Mitch McConnell and his Super PAC billionaire buddies are spending over $8.8 million on new TV ads attacking Dan. They know that if he’s elected, he will hold the 51st vote needed to stop a complete national abortion ban, get money out of politics, and take on the billionaires.

Dan isn’t taking any corporate PAC money because he isn’t in this race to represent corporations or the wealthy. He spent 20 years working for a major corporation, and he knows how important it is for working Americans to have a seat at the table.

The polls are clear: this is a Senate race we can win. But Dan can’t do it alone.

| | Dear Fellow American,

My name is Larry P. Arnn, and I serve as president of Hillsdale College. I'm writing to you today because you're a concerned American who keeps up with current events.

That means you know something is seriously wrong in too many of our nation's schools.

You understand that a fierce ideological battle is raging in classrooms nationwide, and our children are at risk.

**This is no accident.**

The far-Left, guided by a Marxist vision of a radically transformed society, has strategically targeted education, including K-12 classrooms across America.

You can complete your survey at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/marxist-hijacking-of-american-education-survey](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea8027b529134ca0bda15f10a6eb9416&_e=EnqhvW7azLb-qMfcFvnVFsMJikxIl3zRnUgfj9f7-V5xOfuDE1W8NEbKy9ax8EcH4VcRHuCv-SEZGbPdDw8WuMcADSGCGtrpLVvPJVWDPjG819n0fwDgJst8Hxffh2zSpom4ybRQP3BKUsFmLl6Oq5vq4TPOgugEPR9UypStKGwBbRuZYzE9SFN9GFCEFRu0z2VN-zkIjUaXdyFVKrKttRMTvhys5LqJB2ETyMN30Oh8H2Bm-5uIZ53sbEeZmcNTAxaSGcvlVJUfH1Vpn4OP8kYoVCn4xcmn8ePbdPf15Cpd1BUv9uKjYIMk_I0iO-LXrQLbZk0wCXNxxSY1EXzdD_fUxjDhj9oHKziayK72aaVdBfe-H2Q7wTiAG53cgUYV2pqtRbPB2I7X7aDLjslUp62ab_UvsTRxqjyQSP8j3t6UbRbULIl8Qt_tp0BxZx9W)

**Your participation right now could not be more urgent.**

Hearing directly from informed Americans like you will be a great help to us, as well as to policymakers and opinion leaders at all levels.

**You may be shocked by the extreme and false ideas being taught in far too many schools today, such as ...**
* _America was founded on slavery, not freedom, and is systematically racist to this day._

* _White supremacy was woven into America at its founding._

* _Capitalism and free enterprise are sources of poverty and injustice._

* _Americans are not equal citizens but instead belong to one of two groups: "oppressors" or "oppressed." _

* _There is a variety of genders, and gender is changeable._

* _Free speech is dangerous, and speech labeled as "misinformation" should be censored. _

These are radical and anti-American ideas. So, it comes as no surprise that recent surveys show that younger citizens are increasingly drawn to socialism, anarchy, transgenderism, and other destructive ideologies.

**You may think the situation is hopeless. But there is something we can do together to turn the tide.**

Hillsdale College is leading a bold teaching effort to confront these false ideas on the battlefield of education. Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings ... of civil and religious liberty."

We're committed to providing young Americans with a proper grounding in American civics through our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN**.

Our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN** features free online courses, opening and guiding K-12 classical schools, _Imprimis_ --our free digest of liberty--and other educational outreach programs. The goal is to counter the spread of radical and anti-American ideas in our education system.

To help us do this, we would like to know what you and other informed Americans think about the radical agenda of the far-Left, which is pushed in K-12 schools, colleges and universities, businesses, government, and even the U.S. military.

So please help us today by [taking your personalized survey--](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea8027b529134ca0bda15f10a6eb9416&_e=EnqhvW7azLb-qMfcFvnVFsMJikxIl3zRnUgfj9f7-V5xOfuDE1W8NEbKy9ax8EcH4VcRHuCv-SEZGbPdDw8WuMcADSGCGtrpLVvPJVWDPjG819n0fwDgJst8Hxffh2zSpom4ybRQP3BKUsFmLl6Oq5vq4TPOgugEPR9UypStKGwBbRuZYzE9SFN9GFCEFRu0z2VN-zkIjUaXdyFVKrKttRMTvhys5LqJB2ETyMN30Oh8H2Bm-5uIZ53sbEeZmcNTAxaSGcvlVJUfH1Vpn4OP8ulV3bOkFbgjlDdUPMxKtC4PhhaiOtAbGJBp508gwkp2FvEtYcKYRW7J8RvqRGz-JkOF5C45kgebkQR9bK5hArEtOMmHnY6U3WPdbWyO3eUlGv1joPaa5tcoqz__uutPRA4uPMKJVY46CIZcL0Ewx40iiLRVZoAg1bsQdZubPJHQ)your answers will help to guide our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN** , which promotes informed patriotism by educating young Americans.

I firmly believe, and I hope you agree, that a proper education--the kind of education that Hillsdale provides--is the key to preserving American liberty for our children and grandchildren.

At a time when the far-Left explicitly rejects the principles of America's founding--and seeks to expel those principles from our civic life and our major institutions--there is only one way to save America: EDUCATION.

Together, we can fight back with the truth.

Thank you for your time, and thank you in advance for your survey responses.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. We need to hear from informed patriots like you about the state of American education. Hillsdale College is leading a bold teaching effort to confront the false ideas of critical race theory, transgenderism, and socialism on the battlefield of education with our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN**. But today, we need your help!

Will you let us know what you think by taking our **National Opinion Survey on the Marxist Hijacking of American Education**? The survey will take only a few minutes of your time and will help us to defend liberty against radical ideologies.

body:
| Hi Peter, Do you like wasabi? What would you say if I told you that you've probably _never_ tried it before?1 That could be true because roughly 90% of the wasabi out there is "fake." It's dyed horseradish with some additives.1 That's because real wasabi is _very_ expensive. Some wasabi farmers get $150 to $250 for a just a couple of pounds of it.1,2 If that sounds outrageous, consider this — wasabi can take up to 3 years to harvest. It's also notoriously challenging to grow. That's why few farmers cultivate it and many restaurants "fake" it. Even with counterfeit wasabi, though, the tides of inflation keep rising.

Team,

Last week I wrote to you about Caroline, who told her story of needing an abortion in Florida after being diagnosed with brain cancer.

Under Florida’s extreme abortion ban, or the abortion bans my opponent would allow states to implement, Caroline wouldn’t have been able to access the abortion she needed in order to receive treatment to fight her cancer – treatment that gave her more time with her young daughter and her husband.

**Republican governor of Florida Ron DeSantis’s health department threatened criminal charges for television stations that run an ad in which Caroline tells her story. A federal judge had to issue a restraining order in order to prevent the state from further threatening TV stations, literally reminding the department that "It’s the First Amendment, stupid."**

I have seen situations like Caroline’s – where patients had to end wanted pregnancies due to circumstances beyond their control. I know the stakes, and I know the consequences when these decisions are taken out of the hands of patients.

clean_body: Democrats need to gain at least five seats to regain control of the House. | | | | The future of our nation — from lowering health care costs and addressing the opioid epidemic to infrastructure and climate action — hinges on regaining Democratic control of the House of Representatives. This year, all 435 House seats are on the ballot, but the number of highly competitive or "in play" districts is much smaller. Between 30-35 seats are considered highly competitive, these are pivotal races that could decide whether Democrats or Republicans secure the majority in the House. I have been working to ensure that these candidates have the resources they need to succeed. = Let me introduce you to six outstanding candidates from the Pacific Northwest who are in tough races and essential to our success: = The candidates are not just important electorally — they bring a wealth of knowledge, leadership skills, and diverse backgrounds to the House and will help set impactful agendas and uplift working families nationwide. Here are just a few of the reasons why I am so proud to endorse them: Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (WA-03) Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, a small business owner, is focused on restoring economic fairness and bridging the rural-urban divide. Her leadership is crucial for maintaining common-sense policies in Washington's 3rd District. Emily Randall (WA-06) Emily Randall is running to become the first out LGBTQ+ Latina in Congress. Her background in health care and education makes her a fierce advocate for affordable health care and student debt relief. Dr. Kim Schrier (WA-08) Dr. Schrier, a pediatrician, has fought to lower health care costs and protect reproductive rights. She is committed to delivering for Washington's families, particularly around ensuring access to affordable, high-quality health care and climate action. Janelle Bynum (OR-05) A leader in Oregon's state legislature, Janelle Bynum has been a strong voice for small businesses and racial justice. Her experience as a business owner and legislator will serve her district well. Rep. Val Hoyle (OR-04) Val Hoyle, a champion for labor and working families, has been fighting for good jobs and affordable health care. She is running to continue her strong record of service in Oregon's 4th District. Rep. Mary Peltola (AK-AL) Alaska's Mary Peltola made history as the first Alaska Native elected to Congress. She is a dedicated advocate for the environment, fisheries, and Native communities, ensuring Alaska's unique voice is heard. = = = = = = Together, these six women in the Pacific Northwest are fighting for the issues that matter most: affordable health care, climate action, and economic justice. We’re starting off well, but still have a ways to go over the next couple of days.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95507123/506943085/639146828?refcode=em-10.21.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzc4NTJlMy1kMzhmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wcy5sRllkBbKnqpYUtEBY9n4z5ggOvDlAUyWebyGKoU=) | ****[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95507124/506943086/639146828?refcode=em-10.21.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzc4NTJlMy1kMzhmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wcy5sRllkBbKnqpYUtEBY9n4z5ggOvDlAUyWebyGKoU=)****

Now, the good news:
We have an ever-so-slight lead in the latest polls in our race. Plus, election analysts have shifted the race slightly in our favor, we’re one race rating away from being a pure toss up.
These updates show the momentum we’ve built throughout this people-powered campaign. And I’m thankful for every single supporter who helped us get to this point.
**But we can’t get complacent, Peter, because here’s the bad news:**
We are being _heavily outspent_ by Derrick Van Orden and his extremist, deep-pocketed allies and super PACs. They’ve just _doubled_ their ad buys in the most competitive media markets in WI-03. That’s concerning because we _need_ to win those communities to prevail in November.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: What’s going to happen?
body:
Election Day is only a couple weeks away. What is going to happen? | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=55b58fbbcf&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5446f6fb34&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Election Day is only a couple weeks away. What is going to happen?

This week on the podcast I interview veteran pollster Frank Luntz to get his assessment. “It’s going to come down to seven states, and each of them is essentially tied right now,” Frank says. I asked him whether they all could wind up trending in one direction. He said, “Each state is going to come down to different types of voters – Latinos in Nevada and Arizona for example – so they’re not necessarily correlated to each other.”

The polls are very tight across the board. “Kamala has raised and is spending $1 billion and it hasn’t broken the tie,” Frank observes. After a surge as the nominee, Kamala Harris has settled into a point where it’s neck-and-neck. Perhaps it’s not surprising that in such a divided country we are faced with a 50-50 race.

“Trump is talking too much; he’s reminding everyone of why they wanted to move on from him. And Kamala Harris is communicating too little for those who want to know what she’d do as President. Whoever course corrects the most in the final days will have an advantage,” Frank says.

I’ll confess that I’ve had a sense of foreboding regarding Trump’s return for quite some time. If you’ve kept up with me, you know that I’ve been concerned about declining institutions and a general disintegration of the American way of life since I wrote [The War on Normal People](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=699a3b2c8f&e=0f227c2ae3) years ago during my presidential run. I remember being surprised both by Trump’s victory in 2016 and by how close it was in 2020; each time he overperformed his polling. It seemed that people either didn’t want to share they were voting for Trump or his voters weren’t being properly measured.

I asked Frank whether the measurement errors of the past had been addressed. He said that pollsters have tried to adjust their methods of gathering responses but there is no way to know until Election Day.

Will Trump overperform the polls again in November? If so, he almost certainly wins.

I feel like the world has changed so much in the last number of years. Trust and cohesion are down. Alternate realities flourish on just about every social media platform. Americans feel very ornery.

I hope that Kamala edges it out. Frank said, “I believe Harris very well could win at the margins, because the American people have never voted in someone who has a track record like Donald Trump in 2024.” I spoke to someone who was around Donald Trump recently who shared that “his mental decline is evident.” Yikes.

On the other hand, Kamala’s recent media strategy suggests to me that they’re trying to change things up.

It’s going to be close, that’s for sure. We’re a deeply polarized country where 43 of the 50 states are already spoken for, and the voters in 7 states will decide which path we take as a nation.

I’ll be talking to my fair share of those voters. The Forward Party Election Night Watch Party will be in Philadelphia. If you know folks in PA, MI, WI, NV, AZ, GA, or NC feel free to gently reach out. They’re in the driver’s seat. I hope they choose wisely for the rest of us.

For my interview with Frank click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b5fd379bd8&e=0f227c2ae3). To check out the local candidates Forward is supporting including in PA, NV, and NC click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f807f9bd5a&e=0f227c2ae3). To join us for the Forward Election Night Watch Party in Philadelphia click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5458d5e60e&e=0f227c2ae3). In case you can't make it, I'll also be co-hosting a [virtual rally](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=795bbd6407&e=0f227c2ae3) with Open Primaries today at 6:00 PM EST to talk with campaigns around the country at the forefront of democracy reform. History is being made in November one way or the other.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

We're just 15 days from Election Day.
From registering citizens in the states with registration still open and educating potential voters to turning out pro-democracy voters and making sure all of those votes count, our work won't end anytime soon. We need your help to get it all done!
Team: We need your support for our voter registration and voter turnout efforts! Chip in with $24 or whatever you can today -- every dollar goes towards registering voters and protecting your right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=102124_1&amount=24]

Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
Turnout is going to be key , and we're going to make sure we can get every pro-democracy voter to the ballot that we can, armed with the information they need to show up and vote. We're going to make sure every single mail-in ballot is lawfully cast and counted . We’re contacting voters ahead of every key registration, ballot request, and early voting deadline... and those deadlines are coming up fast .
This election will determine whether our democracy goes back to the darkness and conspiracy theories of the recent past or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at just about $3 per new voter -- and voter turnout work can make a huge difference. Pitch in with $24 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=102124_1&amount=24]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102124_1&amount=25]

body:
We must leave no stone unturned in these final days.
| **_A PRIVATE MEMO FROM THE DESK OF DONALD TRUMP JR._**
---
Peter,
---
In its most basic form, politics is a numbers game.
---
The key to victory is to get _EVERY_ America First patriot and conservative leaning independent to the polls between today and November 5th.
---
**We need to flood the ballot boxes with so many LEGAL Republican votes that the Democrats can 't possibly cheat their way to victory! **
---
But to do that, we need to invest every dollar we can in the GOP's ambitious get-out-the-vote programs over these final weeks.
---
With the fate of our free Republic hanging in the balance, we must leave no stone unturned!
---
**Our House GOP Chair is working to turnout voters in both swing states _and_ important battleground House races around the country! **
---
__For about $11, she 's told me that her team can reach a likely Republican voter, encourage them to cast their ballot, and ensure that ballot is counted! __
---

# [Don't let Trump bankrupt Social Security](https://default.salsalabs.org/T64546e9c-164a-46af-a861-24186bb7f43a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Donald Trump's superpower seems to be making things go bankrupt. And if he gets into the White House, it looks like Social Security will be next: [**_New report says Trump proposals could drain Social Security in 6 years_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18f40639-a066-4b20-8733-75a82e656b98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _A [new report](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6204c9b2-906d-4259-b001-b9a89dcb82e9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) out this morning confirms: Donald Trump will gut Social Security. _ _The nonpartisan Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget's new report [concludes](https://default.salsalabs.org/T28e0bd5f-4f9a-419e-85b5-f8e6d6d6a034/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that Trump's Project 2025 agenda will rapidly drain Social Security and cut benefits for seniors by a third – posing such a dire threat to Social Security that the organization's director couldn't recall "'anything that would be this order of magnitude' in its detrimental effect on Social Security's bottom line."_ **This is in stark contrast to plans proposed by[VP Harris](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71d5a8e5-0f8d-485f-bb8b-c96639cd9b9a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), ones aimed at keeping Social Security safe for decades to come.** [**Don't let Trump bankrupt Social Security. Add your name, spread the word, and speak out against Trump's plans to destroy this critical and cherished program.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tad18f425-cb3c-4a82-b526-7b0f2daa9a4c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Friends,
I think I've figured out why Nick LaLota keeps dodging local events. He's so extreme on critical issues like abortion that when the truth comes out, it's devastating.
Watch this clip from our debate. You'll see what I mean right away.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlondebate?refcode=em1021 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlondebate?refcode=em1021]
This is what every voter in our district needs to see. In an overwhelmingly pro-choice district, my opponent's trying to hide just how extreme he is - even deleting his position off his website.
What's he trying to hide? Not only did LaLota cheer overturning Roe v. Wade - he wants to repeal New York's own law protecting abortion access. That means a 12-week abortion ban in New York. Yes, it really could happen here.
And that's not all. He even voted to jail doctors who perform lifesaving abortion care.
No wonder he had no answer in the debate and rambled off about boys in girls' bathrooms in schools.
This is the contrast that will win us this election. My opponent's extremism on abortion vs. common sense solutions. I believe that the decision to have an abortion should be between a woman, her doctor and her god - not the government.
When in Congress, I’ll do everything in my power to stop a national abortion ban. Every voter needs to hear this. Please help us spread the word with just 15 days left.
Thank you for standing with me and fighting the good fight. We're going to win this - together.
-John

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. Last week, Josh Hawley kicked off what his campaign said would be a two-week-long bus tour of Missouri. That's not what ended up happening at all -- and as it turns out, his so-called "bus tour" devolved into a total media fiasco.
**Please let me explain. **
Earlier this month, after 55 days without holding a single public campaign event in Missouri, Josh Hawley was caught literally jetting around on a one-day tour of the state with Harrison Butker.
He was caught on video twice. And since Hawley made bashing private flights a pillar of his 2018 campaign, local press was all over the story:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0463c33e-bb00-4ddd-91e7-3700666e712d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**The very next week, Hawley 's campaign announced a two week bus tour. **
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6eac7f8-1fa7-4522-bb52-5a902f412943?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
They started on Monday, diligently posting photos of each stop along the way. They did the same thing on Tuesday, and Wednesday too.
**Then came Thursday. **
On Thursday morning, people started posting sightings of Josh Hawley's bus, which was illegally taking up six spaces in a private parking lot in St. Louis County -- tow notices stickered to the windshield and everything.
This is when chaos ensued.
The bus didn't move for hours. The windshield accumulated more tow notices.
Here's what happened next:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ccf8e4c9-73a1-4a3d-8655-0e15f6428d09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**This saga is exactly why Missourians can 't trust Hawley to represent our state in the U.S. Senate for another six years. **
Hawley thinks he's above the law. He thinks that if he does something illegal, he should be able to get away with it -- even if any one of us could go to jail for the same thing. We saw it in that private parking lot -- and we saw it when he broke transparency laws and forced Missouri taxpayers to pay his $250,000 fine.
Hawley can't tell the truth. Whether it's blaming someone else for his own mistake or even lying about his own record, we can't trust Hawley to be honest with us about anything -- no matter how trivial.
And finally, Hawley doesn't even want to be here. In fact, he couldn't even bear to spend more than three days at a time in Missouri.
**This election is our opportunity to vote him out. **
Missourians already know that Josh Hawley is a fraud and a coward who only serves himself. That's why he's the most vulnerable GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this November.
If we're able to reinforce that message every day between now and November 5th, I know we can win this race and take back Missouri's U.S. Senate seat. And I'm counting on your help to do it.
**[So, with just 15 days until Election Day, will you chip in $15 to my grassroots campaign today? I don't take a cent from corporate PACs or shady insiders, so I really am relying on your support to close this race out strong.](https://substack.com/redirect/d6eac7f8-1fa7-4522-bb52-5a902f412943?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

| Peter,

This election is about more than just showing up—it’s about mobilizing our communities. In Georgia, every vote has the power to change the course of history, especially in underrepresented communities. Kamala Harris and Patti Hewitt need your help to turn out the vote and ensure victory for all of us.
The voices of communities often overlooked are crucial in this election. When we come together and vote in numbers, we have the power to flip this congressional seat and send Kamala and Patti to Washington to fight for the change we need.

Early voting is open until November 1, 2024! **You can also vote this upcoming weekend: October 26-27**. Find your early voting location here.

## Will White Women White Women Again?
#### Dr. Akilah Cadet
The excitement is palpable. The vibes are immaculate. When Kamala Harris announced her candidacy for President it seemed as if there was a huge exhale reflected in the 1 billion dollars her campaign raised in just three months. It felt like a universal sigh of relief that maybe we could have a chance against former President and aspiring dictator Donald Trump. But immediately I thought "will white women decide the vote?" White women tend to forget that they are white and that they're comfort lies in choosing their whiteness over their gender. The best way to explain this emotion is from an excerpt of my new book [White Supremacy Is All Around: Notes From a Black Disabled Woman In a White World](https://substack.com/redirect/14f4fa21-0763-4daa-810c-2d0d6e69a5e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69ba2c48-aee0-4ee2-9b3d-4e7eb4e8b177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### 'Cause Them Karen's Just Turned Into Terrorists
Remember how white women voted in the 2016 and 2020 elections? I'll remind you. White women voted for Donald "Racist Grab 'em by the Pussy" Trump 42 percent and 55 percent, respectively. More white women voted for Trump after immigrant children were put in cages, women's rights were attacked, Charlottesville, and the list goes on. More white women voted for Trump in 2020 than 2016 because white women choose whiteness over gender. White women vote for white men who uphold patriarchy (and racism and homophobia and transphobia and xenophobia . . .). White women make up 40 percent of voters, while white men comprise 36 percent of voters. White women use their privilege to uphold this status quo. You know, white supremacy.
The way white supremacy works is by maintaining power for the dominant culture, aka white people (priority for cisgender non-disabled heterosexual men) at the expense of women, BIPOC, disabled people, BIPOC immigrants, and the LGBTQ+ communities. This also is the same for access. Middle- and upper-class white people will always have access to opportunities BIPOC and other systemically ignored (marginalized) groups will not to maintain their superiority, power, and control. Think poverty. Think voter suppression. Think women's rights. Think police brutality. Think anti-LGBTQ+ legislation. White women care more about being a white ethnicity than being women. How do I know?
Some vote Republican to keep white heteropatriarchy intact. Some let their racist partners, parents, guardians, and relatives spew hateful things at the dining room table regularly. They think of the power of the white male figures in their lives and want to keep "those same type of men" in power. You know, because he "doesn't really mean that," has a "Black friend," and "loves Jay-Z." White women celebrate their second-class gender as long as it keeps their whiteness first and the prized men in their life happy.
Everyone talks about January 6, 2021, but no one talks about the day before. January 5, 2021, the day Black women saved the country. They flipped the Senate! Black women vote Democrat because our lives depend on it. Yes, our lives! It is the only way we can dismantle the oppressive structures of white supremacy within our country attributed to current-day Trump-era Republicans. White women get more value by voting Republican because there is more power in being a white person in America than being a white woman in America.
The benefit of white supremacy is endless for them! Maybe even more than for white men. I know what you are thinking: um, no. Let's talk about white women. Do you know who Jennifer Schulte is? Or Alison Ettel? Carolyn Bryant Donham? Maybe you know them better as BBQ Becky, Permit Patty, and the white woman whose accusation led to the lynching of fourteen-year-old Emmett Till (by the way, she was found in 2022 and a grand jury declined to indict her; she died at the ripe old age of eighty-eight with no accountability). Even in their harm and murder, white women still have the privilege to be unnamed. To literally live their lives.
Some white women want to ride the coattails, or should I say, the curves, of Black women doing the work and then take all the credit. White women are "progressive," when Black women are "challenging." White women are celebrated for the very things that Black women are discredited for. Instead of stealing from Black women, white women should take action by having conversations with the men in their lives about how they can do better. White women can remember their intersectionality is more than just being a white person.
*****
White women have the power to drastically shift the election so that whiteness is not paramount. So that women can keep and regain rights (remember the Equal Rights Act has not been codified, IVF is on the line, we no longer have Affirmative Action, nor the federal right to abortion). But more importantly, to use their intersectionality for good. White women can vote for themselves, not for their husbands, fathers, and uncles. Just last week Betty Cartledge voted for the very first time at 81 years of age because her husband, who died the year before, didn't see the point in voting. Cartledge said "...I was standing up for my rights."
White women can use their intersectionality to support the first women, women of color, Black, Jamaican, Caribbean, AAPI (Asian American Pacific Islander), Indian, President. They can support a Black woman instead of this unhealthy pattern in American history where Black women have to fix all the problems. White women can use their power and privilege for good. But until then, we will have to wait and see if white women will white women again.

So that women can keep and regain rights (remember the Equal Rights Act has not been codified, IVF is on the line, we no longer have Affirmative Action, nor the federal right to abortion). But more importantly, to use their intersectionality for good. White women can vote for themselves, not for their husbands, fathers, and uncles. Just last week Betty Cartledge voted for the very first time at 81 years of age because her husband, who died the year before, didn't see the point in voting. Cartledge said "...I was standing up for my rights." White women can use their intersectionality to support the first women, women of color, Black, Jamaican, Caribbean, AAPI (Asian American Pacific Islander), Indian, President. They can support a Black woman instead of this unhealthy pattern in American history where Black women have to fix all the problems. White women can use their power and privilege for good. But until then, we will have to wait and see if white women will white women again. A reminder that you can order Dr. Akilah Cadet's book here: . subject: My time at the White House
body:

When I was asked to serve as President Obama's White House technology policy advisor, I wasn't planning on working in politics forever.
At the time, the Obama administration was one of the first to bring technologists to the policy table and to use technology to make government services better and more efficient. So, when I was asked to lead the task force on technology policy, it was an opportunity of a lifetime to make a difference in a meaningful way. (See a throwback photo 📸 here)

body:
Jewish Insider Report Exposes Baugh’s Campaign Ties to Mayor Who Mocked the Holocaust and Allied with Far-Right Extremists

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/f417cf0f77fd/icymi-scott-baugh-campaigns-with-huntington-beach-mayor-who-pushed-antisemitic-conspiracies-and-neo-nazi-rhetoric-18229737?e=7017cc100e)
For immediate release: October 21, 2024
Contact: press@davemin.com

ICYMI: Scott Baugh Campaigns with Huntington Beach Mayor Who Pushed Antisemitic Conspiracies and Neo-Nazi Rhetoric

Jewish Insider Report Exposes Baugh’s Campaign Ties to Mayor Who Mocked the Holocaust and Allied with Far-Right Extremists

IRVINE, CA — A recent report in Jewish Insider (https://jewishinsider.com/2024/10/scott-baugh-gracey-van-der-mark/) revealed that Scott Baugh, the Republican nominee for California’s 47th Congressional District, has repeatedly worked to support Huntington Beach Mayor Gracey Van Der Mark, despite her history of antisemitic rhetoric (https://orangecounty.adl.org/news/anti-defamation-league-joins-call-for-hb-finance-commissioners-removal/) , Holocaust denial, (https://www.ocweekly.com/hb-finance-commissioner-called-blacks-colored-people-on-social-media-2/) and affiliations with far-right extremist groups (https://www.ocweekly.com/hb-finance-commissioner-called-blacks-colored-people-on-social-media-2/) . Baugh has not only accepted Van Der Mark’s endorsement but has campaigned alongside her on multiple occasions (https://dccc.org/tomorrow-scott-baugh-campaigns-alongside-holocaust-denier-white-supremacist-sympathizer-gracey-van-der-mark/) , demonstrating a troubling alliance with an official
known for spreading hate.

Read The Full Article Here (https://jewishinsider.com/2024/10/scott-baugh-gracey-van-der-mark/)

“Scott Baugh, the Republican nominee running in California’s Orange County-based 47th Congressional District, campaigned with and touts an endorsement from a local official with a history of antisemitism and affiliations with a series of well-known far-right extremists.”

Dave Min, State Senator and Democratic nominee for CA-47, denounced Baugh’s decision to ally with Van Der Mark.

“Scott Baugh has repeatedly demonstrated that he is unfit to represent this diverse district,” said Dave Min. “He has previously declared that he believes wokism– celebrating the values of diversity and inclusion– is the greatest threat America has ever faced, and he is campaigning proudly alongside a well-known anti-Semitic Holocaust denier who has worked closely with white nationalists and far-right militia movements. Orange County deserves leaders who will stand up against hate, not embrace it.”

Van Der Mark has a well-documented record of making anti-Semitic statements (https://www.latimes.com/socal/daily-pilot/news/story/2023-08-05/huntington-beachs-27-year-old-declaration-on-human-dignity-in-jeopardy) , including questioning the Holocaust on social media (https://www.ocregister.com/2018/09/20/orange-county-gop-endorses-school-board-candidate-criticized-for-alleged-anti-semitic-and-racist-social-media-post/) , joining forces with neo-Nazis (https://www.ocweekly.com/anti-defamation-league-joins-call-for-hb-finance-commissioners-removal-2/) and white supremacists (https://www.thedailybeast.com/gracey-van-der-mark-and-tito-ortiz-are-powering-the-wildest-huntington-beach-city-council-race-ever/) , and making racist (https://www.latimes.com/socal/daily-pilot/news/story/2023-09-07/huntington-beach-introduces-new-human-dignity-policy-censures-council-member) and Islamophobic statements
(https://www.loscerritosnews.net/2022/09/17/la-mirada-chamber-invited-alt-right-racist-to-moderate-school-board-debate/) . She was previously removed from two school boards because of her racist statements and actions (https://www.latimes.com/socal/daily-pilot/news/tn-dpt-me-hb-gracey-20180508-story.html) . On the Huntington Beach City Council, Van Der Mark has continued to embrace hate, leading the charge to eliminate the Human Rights Commission (https://www.latimes.com/socal/daily-pilot/news/story/2023-08-02/huntington-beach-council-cuts-human-relations-committee-others-after-decades-of-service) , which was created in the late 1990s after a number of racially motivated murders to address hate in HB, andpushing for book bans (https://www.ocregister.com/2023/06/16/huntington-beach-councilmember-proposes-rules-to-screen-childrens-books-in-city-libraries-for-obscenity-or-pornography/) in Surf City’s public libraries.

Despite widespread condemnation from local Jewish leaders and the Anti-Defamation League (https://www.ocweekly.com/anti-defamation-league-joins-call-for-hb-finance-commissioners-removal-2/) , Baugh continues to tout her endorsement on his campaign website (https://image.jewishinsider.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/15202812/Baugh-Endorsement.png?_gl=1*nw0a2c*_ga*MTI2Mzk3NjY2OC4xNzI5NTI5MDY1*_ga_7HK4TGWTHS*MTcyOTUzMTUyNy4yLjEuMTcyOTUzMzUzMy4xNS4wLjA.&_ga=2.10930036.1500356765.1729529066-1263976668.1729529065) and appeared with her at campaign events as recently as this year (https://image.jewishinsider.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/15202754/Baug-Aug-2024-Event.png?_gl=1*1besnkg*_ga*MTI2Mzk3NjY2OC4xNzI5NTI5MDY1*_ga_7HK4TGWTHS*MTcyOTUzMTUyNy4yLjEuMTcyOTUzMzU3MS42MC4wLjA.&_ga=2.10930036.1500356765.1729529066-1263976668.1729529065) .

Baugh has dragged Orange County voters through the mud with him for decades, leaving behind a trail of corruption and scandal, including:
* Changing voter registrations without consent: As Chair of the Orange County Republican Party, Baugh was at the center of a scandal where as many as 600 Orange County residents had their voter registrations changed to Republican without their knowledge (https://www.ocregister.com/2006/03/01/democrats-question-gop-increase/) – and led to 12 arrests (https://www.ocregister.com/2006/10/27/12-charged-in-voter-scandal/) .
* Indicted on more than 20 criminal charges: In 1996, Baugh was indicted on more than 20 criminal charges (https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1996-03-23-mn-50374-story.html) , including four felonies (https://bpr.studentorg.berkeley.edu/2024/10/04/scott-baugh-would-serve-himself-not-ca-47/) , for violating campaign finance laws and persuading someone to commit perjury (https://www.recordnet.com/story/news/1996/03/23/gop-assemblyman-indicted/50847880007/) . He admitted to committing nine violations (https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1999-jul-28-mn-60251-story.html) of the California Political Reform Act and was forced to pay tens of thousands of dollars in fines (https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1999-jul-28-me-60372-story.html) .
* Worked to disenfranchise voters: Baugh was a founding chairman (https://baughforcongress.com/about/) of an organization that spread voter disinformation and attempted to disenfranchise California voters (https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2021-06-25/vigilantes-claimed-voter-fraud-a-thousand-false-leads-later-investigators-found-one-case) —long before the 2020 election.

###

California’s 47th is an open DCCC Red To Blue Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country.

From day one, we’ve heard from the naysayers that the polling wasn’t on our side. But now, with less than two weeks left, we’ve not just closed the gap, we’re leading by just one point. Fellow patriot, but here’s the bad news. We’re still in the margin of error. That means this is anyone’s race. And Sherrod Brown just closed out a $30+ million fundraising quarter. He literally has tens of thousands of millions to spend to attack me in the most critical time of this race. The balance of power in the Senate lies firmly in Ohio. You know that. The Democrats in Washington know that. That’s why we must make EVERY DAY count between now and November 5th. I am counting on you! Thanks, Bernie Moreno Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Here’s just a small sample of what he said about yours truly: **_“Sleazebag”
“Major lowlife”
“A bad person, a sick person”_** Yet again, this is just more of the same attacks he throws at me every chance he gets. Whether he’s at a rally in Iowa, Pennsylvania, Florida, or right here in California, he just can’t stop thinking about me. But that’s not all he said. He attacked California’s election integrity, setting up future claims of election fraud when he inevitably loses our state. Even worse, he said as president, he would withhold aid to California in an act of political retribution, in its effort to fight wildfires. _Who does that?_ The worst thing he said was during an interview on _Fox News_ when he stated that opponents like me were “the enemy within” and that he may need to use the military to go after us. | | | Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.

[ ](https://srod4wi.us/l/AlwnvIDcpTSU)

Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.

Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

This is President Trump’s strongest supporter in the House, Byron Donalds.
I grew up in Brooklyn, New York, raised by a single mother who sacrificed everything for me and my siblings.
I’ve had some thick skin from a young age - so if it’s a radical-left news anchor trying to gaslight me for supporting Trump, or House Democrats going low with rude slurs, I’m never going to back down until the fight is won.
**I take that to heart even today as I continue the fight for the MAGA Movement, and I do it ALL for you.**
Look, I’m not easily frightened, but losing the House Majority worries me.
These next 26 days of the election are truly our LAST CHANCE to save the country. I know President Trump says it often, but we will NEVER have another chance like this in our lifetimes.

Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3844deb7d37744c091b25dbbb958045f&_e=aZnE6VeiZhJ5HOeCjp6EJ0mlF7FBjEUnTVWE45Gb2SiAD85Xc5QStXK3FcOW7EAqKKXC1n8rbLjdZcz1u6tBZibBnem5TwLyCsCmuFxRCQk6lqlgHlduZwpPiF2dsk-qyKYny6yuBvnnJkJ_GlnfaFsO2w9Rb4z4yOLSR-WC856wCv2EBPaybHxOsOmw0ScMnDaAwBwh-Ze_LTRO1nFvBN2OZ2156nvfyz4NhvzIzuKP1DQixY6Jl53ib796m5TgVol8tRkie8qayf5EIKJ6AvuBY4v6kXWB39rL8b4rOP4eNpEhbOCGXCW9Np1DYFNGMJQlKvxlh7fPhzc-9YxGjRHTEWiYYZje693-EIwKVxH2YhX0fgDtIIn9N_Y4IT4iplB27ayNWYnS4oZsF2EQLh57Zsex3-GdS0-qH8bIczA%3D)

After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3844deb7d37744c091b25dbbb958045f&_e=aZnE6VeiZhJ5HOeCjp6EJ0mlF7FBjEUnTVWE45Gb2SiAD85Xc5QStXK3FcOW7EAqKKXC1n8rbLjdZcz1u6tBZibBnem5TwLyCsCmuFxRCQk6lqlgHlduZwpPiF2dsk-qyKYny6yuBvnnJkJ_GlnfaFsO2w9Rb4z4yOLSR-WC856wCv2EBPaybHxOsOmw0ScMnDaAwBwh-Ze_LTRO1nFvBN2OZ2156nvfyz4NhvzIzuKP1DQixY6Jl53ib796m5TgVol8tRkie8qayf5EIKJ6AnUvJNge91KFl28iQEfaGBhYU2ogdsk_U95XIAHSWn7kgQ44AE3PvaBSr7clqouhoJLdlr-bXU8-uwtE7ezbBbquvtqSPgNOkcfxboBEIHX3V9qa-DS4SNNDT-fcGirDIY4_OB3mGt5wz8SOsrWH4zM%3D)

I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor.

Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement.

I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it.

_**I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record.**_

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3844deb7d37744c091b25dbbb958045f&_e=aZnE6VeiZhJ5HOeCjp6EJ0mlF7FBjEUnTVWE45Gb2SiAD85Xc5QStXK3FcOW7EAqKKXC1n8rbLjdZcz1u6tBZibBnem5TwLyCsCmuFxRCQk6lqlgHlduZwpPiF2dsk-qyKYny6yuBvnnJkJ_GlnfaFsO2w9Rb4z4yOLSR-WC856wCv2EBPaybHxOsOmw0ScMnDaAwBwh-Ze_LTRO1nFvBN2OZ2156nvfyz4NhvzIzuKP1DQixY6Jl53ib796m5TgVol8tRkie8qayf5EIKJ6ApHDdb9HSOyqmMmQDFAMqdkXmIdsEwWz9OdfkeVAwaGg4G9qH42NNL6kjPIqpaxoZeJpqWe3r8QmHlYa6QBU4n0LYk8RZ_f_sZ2pJ5EGpfrd99JyunS-l_8UwbKu2gw7DGjcjreM6_X11vaMWnG9Pu4%3D)

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3844deb7d37744c091b25dbbb958045f&_e=aZnE6VeiZhJ5HOeCjp6EJ0mlF7FBjEUnTVWE45Gb2SiAD85Xc5QStXK3FcOW7EAqKKXC1n8rbLjdZcz1u6tBZibBnem5TwLyCsCmuFxRCQk6lqlgHlduZwpPiF2dsk-qyKYny6yuBvnnJkJ_GlnfaFsO2w9Rb4z4yOLSR-WC856wCv2EBPaybHxOsOmw0ScMnDaAwBwh-Ze_LTRO1nFvBN2OZ2156nvfyz4NhvzIzuKP1DQixY6Jl53ib796m5TgVol8tRkie8qayf5EIKJ6AqkHyiJJGnY-aq8p8yZM70jwQFEVFKJOhXNGJcWomBe1NdLRu8obDsMSX824Dhu6OV4oUPPTRO_8MBIkQ6MisZW4XZada-JUKwhAacwN_gRGVkb9Wai4orNfNHZPwlGqsN81MKnCo_4pw81y1O7jmII%3D)

I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and **if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it!**

Here's where I need your help, Fellow Patriot. **We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me.** The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me.

My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. Peter, did you see what Donald Trump just said about January 6th?

That’s why our campaign is working so hard to not only re-elect Pramila, but to turn out voters in critical swing states across the country, too.
We’ve partnered with the Harris-Walz campaign to call voters in swing districts, and Pramila is personally on the ground leading door-knocking teams in battleground states. **We’ve already contacted tens of thousands of voters, and we’re not stopping until polls are closed.**

Peter,

We’re in a dead heat, Peter.

The latest polling in the Wisconsin Senate race shows I am up **just one point.**

That’s both good and bad.

Good -- because we’ve tightened this race. We’ve put Tammy Baldwin and Senate Democrats on their heels. Because of our hard work, this race is a TOSS UP. The momentum is with us as we enter the final two weeks of this race.

But here’s where I am worried, Peter.

The Democrats might be down, _but they aren’t going to take this polling or ratings change lying down._

They are going to come out harder now that the Senate majority is on the line right here in Wisconsin.

So I am going to ask for your help in an unorthodox way. **I am going to ask for just one dollar.**

Why just one dollar? Because I am looking for folks all over the country to step up. It’s our strength in numbers -- not large donors, or Hollywood support that will help win this race.

Peter, I’ve personally invested money in this race -- something I am proud to have done - but I need to know if you’re part of this team, too.

The latest polling in the Wisconsin Senate race shows I am up just one point. That’s both good and bad. Good -- because we’ve tightened this race. We’ve put Tammy Baldwin and Senate Democrats on their heels. Because of our hard work, this race is a TOSS UP. The momentum is with us as we enter the final two weeks of this race. But here’s where I am worried, Peter. The Democrats might be down, but they aren’t going to take this polling or ratings change lying down. They are going to come out harder now that the Senate majority is on the line right here in Wisconsin. So I am going to ask for your help in an unorthodox way. I am going to ask for just one dollar. Why just one dollar? Because I am looking for folks all over the country to step up. It’s our strength in numbers -- not large donors, or Hollywood support that will help win this race. Peter, I’ve personally invested money in this race -- something I am proud to have done - but I need to know if you’re part of this team, too. I want to have an additional 5,000 contributions before the end of the day. Friend, for well over a year now, you’ve been getting messages from my husband Mike Rogers, his campaign staff, and his supporters about how this is the most consequential election of our lifetime, why Mike is the best man for the job, and why if Mike wins, we take back the Senate.
All of that is true.

**[But after 13 months on the campaign trail — I wanted to share with you a bit of my story, and how I know that Mike Rogers is a man worthy of your support. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f5cbb6294ddf47a391cef7f78754e547&_e=ps79Gu1V3d_5BfqNIkhrZFyTIrECllmtgnHfS60xWMoZxbp182VARIXaWcE68DGz6_2xyEh8kcENjGqVJLT2qgYTZWWB7s0hnbQngSL6iBRtuU16PEQiwgJHTTnG1UlpItzb9jlqV-XweBk1pdgbu2wDGF8WEPlppt6tyDj_TcDv8XHBIansbEweax51wqhIVo9Srd-yQeKfsbY2W_WshPPDtvuMgaNOGvbnfwgcRsl7jafzIAWnRUbP6R52EgoncJJHk-JVMGjE4VGrJ5PMuUGaY8BsZpQzwCrpISlZ3ga9F36xI7LYDvdgKERCKdHM4_inHsWYI5lMObQnxSXTF9AEILzGlmtBsOk8TIROdkRX50yrUnVS5LJ92PI6xcI1m7nx8gf55b56TZQYFi24hUOYqhL2K69OaTonrEjT0q5Wd1M0fHK0MP1fHljMxX1gsIIHFrxz1gCpMQvQuBVzdUh2xt14TLiCxt5sJOC5d-A%3D)**

I was deployed to Iraq in the height of the conflict in the Middle East while working for the Department of Defense.

Here’s a picture of me from back then:
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f5cbb6294ddf47a391cef7f78754e547&_e=ps79Gu1V3d_5BfqNIkhrZFyTIrECllmtgnHfS60xWMoZxbp182VARIXaWcE68DGz6_2xyEh8kcENjGqVJLT2qgYTZWWB7s0hnbQngSL6iBRtuU16PEQiwgJHTTnG1UlpItzb9jlqV-XweBk1pdgbu2wDGF8WEPlppt6tyDj_TcDv8XHBIansbEweax51wqhIVo9Srd-yQeKfsbY2W_WshPPDtvuMgaNOGvbnfwgcRsl7jafzIAWnRUbP6R52EgoncJJHk-JVMGjE4VGrJ5PMuUGaY8BsZpQzwCrpISlZ3ga9F36xI7LYDvdgKERCKdHM4_inHsWYI5lMObQnxSXTFwjjtIfGedsZLq8vYY-wKDNHq74USIVkEfZDnQm783JAg6aFiPfBgkTnD0VsIVgEkmJiDY229-lLCqqRMBiUIsl3OM_6ZDUIo0JgvKHKZgCJxjNWIWo3ysxMf5uDMm6phUOpFs8laEMUTNzg89JU8ZE%3D)

And on a fateful day, my team and I were traveling through the city of Baghdad. You have to understand that just getting around the region as Americans at this point was incredibly dangerous. We were told to stay in the middle lane of the highway, to keep as much of a distance between us and the explosive devices that lined the roads as possible. The terrorists were always waiting for their opportunity to attack. **_[Suddenly — it happened. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f5cbb6294ddf47a391cef7f78754e547&_e=ps79Gu1V3d_5BfqNIkhrZFyTIrECllmtgnHfS60xWMoZxbp182VARIXaWcE68DGz6_2xyEh8kcENjGqVJLT2qgYTZWWB7s0hnbQngSL6iBRtuU16PEQiwgJHTTnG1UlpItzb9jlqV-XweBk1pdgbu2wDGF8WEPlppt6tyDj_TcDv8XHBIansbEweax51wqhIVo9Srd-yQeKfsbY2W_WshPPDtvuMgaNOGvbnfwgcRsl7jafzIAWnRUbP6R52EgoncJJHk-JVMGjE4VGrJ5PMuUGaY8BsZpQzwCrpISlZ3ga9F36xI7LYDvdgKERCKdHM4_inHsWYI5lMObQnxSXTFx0A_6lDj6tHYtLuOquGrQoO3qVonadMRMmyhJBjIw-evgvzrBlp59pBltrUb9piqlaDwCswyZWmRnuJt8FEec3gKZdHWqg51jx8XVFbZoCn5Vhe0kukCMNT7h-i-o1vgPakvExdoe9FE5s1oOYUbI8%3D)_** I can still remember what it was like to have my head spinning, with my ears ringing and surrounded by smoke. When I finally realized what happened, I was incredibly grateful to have made it out alive, as others in the car next to us were not as lucky. After this incident, my husband often jokes that when there’s a bump in the night at home,_he sends me to check things out and make sure we are safe_. **[But the truth is that my husband, Mike Rogers, is the strongest, most courageous, and honorable man I’ve ever known.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f5cbb6294ddf47a391cef7f78754e547&_e=ps79Gu1V3d_5BfqNIkhrZFyTIrECllmtgnHfS60xWMoZxbp182VARIXaWcE68DGz6_2xyEh8kcENjGqVJLT2qgYTZWWB7s0hnbQngSL6iBRtuU16PEQiwgJHTTnG1UlpItzb9jlqV-XweBk1pdgbu2wDGF8WEPlppt6tyDj_TcDv8XHBIansbEweax51wqhIVo9Srd-yQeKfsbY2W_WshPPDtvuMgaNOGvbnfwgcRsl7jafzIAWnRUbP6R52EgoncJJHk-JVMGjE4VGrJ5PMuUGaY8BsZpQzwCrpISlZ3ga9F36xI7LYDvdgKERCKdHM4_inHsWYI5lMObQnxSXTF3OeoY_Kg3-zSLXGs8UI0Fck_mFNBvZA4yUFacD4m-gTk-Hdh1Wtd_aKOnCGogEKB-s2sE3ftzYrUHygaSoSarmn5PvhDFBU7smjyXYHLBHnvESPyj0oUaZxFMoBbf_mZ05bJxnLjIYk9Hi1J97Wtn0%3D)** It takes guts to get back into politics these days — especially with the folks on the other side spending tens of millions of dollars to lie about you and your family in the name of scoring cheap political points. As a young man, Mike fought cancer and worked two jobs — one on the floor of an automotive factory, and one in security — just to put himself through college. My husband is an Army veteran, former FBI agent, and even chaired the House Intelligence Committee in the tough days after 9/11. He also has been taking the fight to Communist China — going so far as to break from his fellow Republicans to blow the whistle on the threats that the CCP poses. _It just doesn’t get any tougher than that. _
Mike is the kind of man that does what is right, no matter the personal consequence.

**[And he is the kind of man that is deserving of your support. Because with Mike in the Senate, you can know that there is someone in your corner, fighting for you and preserving our great American values.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f5cbb6294ddf47a391cef7f78754e547&_e=ps79Gu1V3d_5BfqNIkhrZFyTIrECllmtgnHfS60xWMoZxbp182VARIXaWcE68DGz6_2xyEh8kcENjGqVJLT2qgYTZWWB7s0hnbQngSL6iBRtuU16PEQiwgJHTTnG1UlpItzb9jlqV-XweBk1pdgbu2wDGF8WEPlppt6tyDj_TcDv8XHBIansbEweax51wqhIVo9Srd-yQeKfsbY2W_WshPPDtvuMgaNOGvbnfwgcRsl7jafzIAWnRUbP6R52EgoncJJHk-JVMGjE4VGrJ5PMuUGaY8BsZpQzwCrpISlZ3ga9F36xI7LYDvdgKERCKdHM4_inHsWYI5lMObQnxSXTF32tKORBliFFW9f_pCgFE0ZXb04M7wjiVxE-LdcHajMzenIbwRprgPUX9eSBmv0-VWRPalpClmUk94mtHfbFx8Zck8aVZ_EHC5EOF3z5aJGi-J-yO4fB9Ae_XnS2eVnofe5vKscpGaYZ055SGtDTAuA%3D) **

body:
I want to share a bit with you about where I come from and why I’m in this fight.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95517351/506977749/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjY2NjAwMi1lOThmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PtgsGHk8_7vZ_-V0dSSt4tsjBIqBNx1oWw_h3a8z3qE=) In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to [_**chip in to my campaign to protect KS-03**_ _**.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95517352/506977750/1125622622?refcode=email_102124_My-story&amounts=5,25,50,75,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjY2NjAwMi1lOThmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PtgsGHk8_7vZ_-V0dSSt4tsjBIqBNx1oWw_h3a8z3qE=) But before I do that, I want to share a bit with you about where I come from and why I’m in this fight. **I was raised by a single mom** who spent 20 years serving in the Army. My mom taught me the value of hard work, and the importance of serving your community and your country — values I carried with me as I worked multiple jobs to get myself through college and law school. **I have dedicated my life to public service** — after I graduated, I got to work helping Native American reservations build communities and economically thrive. This work inspired me to apply to be a White House Fellow, where I got to work under President Obama in the Department of Transportation. **I ran for Congress to give Kansans a voice** who will represent their values in Washington, not the values of corporate special interest groups. Peter,
Today, October 21st, marks the start of early voting in Brevard County and Indian River County. This election isn't just another checkbox on the calendar — it's a defining moment for our nation, and YOU have the power to steer the course.
Now is the time for **ACTION:** the radical left would love nothing more than to slow you down on Election Day. They'll use every excuse in the book — long lines, bad weather, traffic — to keep you from casting your ballot. But that’s why early voting is so crucial.
_Beat them at their own game._ Starting today, for Brevard County and Indian River County- you can vote at any of the designated locations listed below:

[Brevard County's Early Voting Locations>>](https://link.support.mike4congress.)
* Dr. Joe Lee Smith Community Center / 415 Stone Street in Cocoa
* Kiwanis Island Park Gymnasium / 950 Kiwanis Island Park Road in Merritt Island
* Max K. Rodes Park Community Center / 3410 Flanagan Avenue in West Melbourne
* Tony Rosa Palm Bay Community Center / 1502 Port Malabar Boulevard in Palm Bay
* Scotty Culp Municipal Complex / 565 Cassia Boulevard in Satellite Beach
* Titusville Public Library / 2121 South Hopkins Avenue in Titusville
* Titusville Elections Office / 400 South Street, Suite 1-F in Titusville
* Ted Whitlock Community Center / 370 Championship Circle NW in Palm Bay
* Viera Regional Community Center / 2300 Judge Fran Jamieson Way in Viera
* Wickham Park Community Center / 2815 Leisure Way in Melbourne

[Indian River Early Voting Locations>>](https://link.support.mike4congress.)

[Orange County Early Voting Locations>> ](https://link.support.mike4congress.)

In Brevard County, Early Voting Locations are open weekdays from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. and this Saturday, October 27th, from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
In Indian River County, Early Voting Locations will be open from today through November 2, 2024, 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. daily.
In Orange County, Early Voting Locations will be open from October 21, 2024, through November 3, 2024, 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. daily.
Already have a mail-in ballot? No problem. You can securely drop it at any of these locations.
Remember, if you wait until Election Day (November 5th), you MUST vote at your assigned precinct. Why risk it? Get out there early, avoid the chaos, and make sure your voice is heard!
Questions about voting? Email my team at mike4congress.com. We’re here to help.
The time to stand up for America is NOW. Don't let the radical left control the future. Get your vote in early, and let's take this fight to the finish line together!
For America, Mike Haridopolos

Republican Nominee for FL-8

body:
Folks, I'm going to be blunt: I need you to chip in five bucks.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred]
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred&amount=5]
We have to raise $500,000 every single day to keep up with Ted Cruz and his wealthy extremist donors. I simply can't do that without your help. Will you please split a $5 donation to help me defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred&amount=5]
If we win this race, I will work in the Senate to prevent a national abortion ban, protect our democracy, and fight against attacks on Social Security and Medicare.
And polls show we can win – three in a row have me statistically tied with Ted Cruz.

Listen team, I really need your help. We have a plan to defend the Senate, but the 2024 elections are evolving at lightning speed.

I know I don't have to tell you how _razor-thin_ our Senate majority is. If we lose _TWO_ seats, MAGA Republicans could take control -- and then they'll have free rein to force the GOP's agenda on the entire country.
