This is the most important congressional race in the country. Will you help us finish strong and kick Jim Jordan out of Congress for good?
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

**As the daughter of a 5th generation Ohioan (my mom was born and raised in Columbus), I’m asking you to join me and help Sherrod fight back.**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Over the weekend, Israeli forces intensified their genocide in Gaza and
violent attacks against Lebanon — we cannot look away or ignore this.

In northern Gaza, more than 400,000 displaced and starving Palestinians
who are trapped with nowhere to go are being forced to leave or die. The
Israeli military has not only continued bombing and shooting Palestinians
taking shelter in refugee camps, hospitals, and schools, but it also
separated men and boys from women, blindfolding and binding their arms,
with reports of many being arrested, tortured, or killed.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241021-arms-embargo/?source=em20241021-36084&akid=36084%2E1203867%2E53Xipp ]Tweet by @HossamShabat: Israeli occupation forces continue ethnically
cleansing the north. Today, they attacked a school in the Jabalia refugee
camp and forced people out of it. Then they lined them up and shot anyone
who dared to move. Any male over the age of 16 is being detained,
tortured, and investigated. Many people who are being lined up are sick
individuals, such as amputees, cancer patients, and young kids who are
being asked to stand in line for hours. The situation is catastrophic.

Israel is carrying out its final stage of ethnic cleansing in northern
Gaza while the world watches and our government provides the bombs and
weapons to do it.

Meanwhile, the Israeli military is wreaking similar havoc in Lebanon,
using the same strategy they’ve used in Gaza over the past year.
Yesterday, thousands of Lebanese civilians were sent into a panic after
Israel issued last-minute evacuation warnings to residential communities
in Beirut and southern Lebanon. Israel then proceeded to bomb these
densely populated areas overnight, including near Beirut’s international
airport.

We still don’t know the extent of casualties and damage in Lebanon, but
the UN says more than 400,000 Lebanese children — almost 10% of the entire
country’s population — have been displaced due to Israel’s attacks.

Israel’s far-right government led by genocidal Prime Minister Netanyahu
cannot continue to go unchecked like this,
Peter.

The Biden administration said last week that it’s giving Israel 30 days to
improve the situation, but it continues providing billions of dollars
worth of bombs and weapons and is even sending U.S. troops to serve
alongside the IDF, likely violating the Leahy Law and the War Powers Act.

We cannot wait until after the election to stop this genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241021-arms-embargo/?source=em20241021-36084&akid=36084%2E1203867%2E53Xipp ]Add your name to tell the Biden administration: stop violating U.S. and
international law by arming and enabling Israel’s genocide — we demand an
arms embargo NOW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241021-arms-embargo/?source=em20241021-36084&akid=36084%2E1203867%2E53Xipp ]Add Your Name

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

20 years ago, the junior Senator for Illinois gave the keynote address at the Democratic National Convention to talk about how the upcoming election was a practice in hope.

My former boss, Barack Obama, talked about how **“a skinny kid with a funny name,”** could believe he belonged in America and posed a challenge to the crowd of Democrats, **“Do we participate in a politics of cynicism or a politics of hope?”**

_**As a fellow American with a “funny name,” I approach politics with hope and with pragmatism.**_

My parents came to this country to pursue the American dream and met their hope with the tireless work of building a new life from scratch in a completely foreign place. When I’ve asked how they managed it all, their answer was basically taking it one step at a time.

Americans are frustrated by the politics-as-usual standstill. Sometimes the dysfunction feels insurmountable, but I’ve spent my career tackling big problems head on, breaking down complex issues into manageable steps to deliver real results. __It’s what my parents taught me.__

I’m running for Congress to take on the tough fights and deliver real results for everyone who has been told they “have a funny name” or they don’t belong.

I’m running for Congress to help make the American dream that’s been pushed out of reach for too many easier to reach.

Dear Peter,
A just-released survey revealed that **33% of parents have reported rising child care costs over the past year.** And with almost 1 in 6 home care workers living in poverty, care workers already can’t afford to support their families.
The care crisis is only getting worse. Congress must act to make the major investments needed to fix our broken care system.
Families cannot afford an extension of the 2017 Trump Tax Law for corporations and billionaires, which next year will give **the top 1% a tax break of more than $60,000 while care workers will receive less than $500,** on average. People making less than $114,000 on average saw “no change in earnings” from the corporate tax rate cut, while top executive salaries increased sharply.
Trillions of dollars that families desperately need invested in care could instead be given once again to the wealthiest individuals and corporations if the current tax law is extended, and it’s up to us to mobilize a huge public outcry to stop it from happening.
[******_Add your name today to call on Congress to reject extending the Trump Tax Law and invest in the care our families and workers desperately need._******](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95524200/507000811/1229493479?ms=102124_trumptaxpetition&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOWExM2YwMy1mYzhmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dWv3BR-ltCaWqb55opECuVyhBFb9zYiEIsLiKictkxU=&emci=5c5b8514-908d-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=39a13f03-fc8f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=864787)
****__[ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95524203/507000814/1229493479?ms=102124_trumptaxpetition&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOWExM2YwMy1mYzhmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dWv3BR-ltCaWqb55opECuVyhBFb9zYiEIsLiKictkxU=&emci=5c5b8514-908d-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=39a13f03-fc8f-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=864787)__****
The same survey showed that nearly half of parents are already facing the challenges of increased child care costs, unexpected closures, or the struggle to find care at all. At the same time, many care workers can’t afford to feed their families, and face exploitation, harassment and stolen wages.
The equation is broken, and families on all sides lose out. **The expiration of the Trump Tax Law is a chance to fix the broken equation. **

clean_body: We have a critical opportunity ahead of us. Dear Peter, A just-released survey revealed that 33% of parents have reported rising child care costs over the past year. And with almost 1 in 6 home care workers living in poverty, care workers already can’t afford to support their families. The care crisis is only getting worse. Congress must act to make the major investments needed to fix our broken care system. Families cannot afford an extension of the 2017 Trump Tax Law for corporations and billionaires, which next year will give the top 1% a tax break of more than $60,000 while care workers will receive less than $500, on average. People making less than $114,000 on average saw “no change in earnings” from the corporate tax rate cut, while top executive salaries increased sharply. Trillions of dollars that families desperately need invested in care could instead be given once again to the wealthiest individuals and corporations if the current tax law is extended, and it’s up to us to mobilize a huge public outcry to stop it from happening. ** The same survey showed that nearly half of parents are already facing the challenges of increased child care costs, unexpected closures, or the struggle to find care at all. At the same time, many care workers can’t afford to feed their families, and face exploitation, harassment and stolen wages. The equation is broken, and families on all sides lose out. The expiration of the Trump Tax Law is a chance to fix the broken equation. Elected officials will have a decision: allow the wealthy and corporations to keep benefiting from huge tax breaks, or use those resources to invest in the care infrastructure that millions of families and workers need. Care workers and families are counting on us,**Peter. **** Thank you for standing with us in the fight for care. In solidarity, Care in Action

I wish I could tell you that Republican Congressmen investigated those horror stories ... brought the vicious guards to justice ... and had our fellow patriots transferred out of there.

But that’s not the case.

**Patriot, what’s being done to January 6 peaceful protesters is so demonic, so foul, that they BEGGED to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Please allow me to share their gut-wrenching cry for help with you.

Here’s what they’re suffering (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* **Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy****through a 4 inch by 10 inch window of cold metal doors**
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

But there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for years ... in AMERICA.

**They end their heartbreaking letter by BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where Taliban and Islamic terrorists who’ve killed US troops get better treatment.**

But there’s something you can do about it.

I’m Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 47 years.

You’ve probably seen me on cable news or heard me on talk radio.

**I’m the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win. And my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials can be THROWN OUT.**

And I’m taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn’t commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: some things you never get used to
disclaimer_text: Paid for by End Citizens United-Nonfederal
body:
I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president attack me personally. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22369%2E4449941%2ENuXZhA)
---
Friends, it’s Ruben.

I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president come after me. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.

That’s always going to be weird to me.

But that’s what Donald Trump did when he came here in August. Again in September. On social media earlier this week. And again, this week, in Arizona.

He came back because Arizona is critical to his chances this year, and winning this state is personal for him after we beat him back in 2020\.

He knows if he can help defeat me he’s got an open path to the White House. He’s got to go through us to win.

That raises the stakes of our campaign beyond just one seat in the U.S. Senate, and beyond our Senate Majority. This race is about beating Trump, once and for all.

I need you with me to do it. [**Any donation at all that you can afford to give helps us fight back. Our average contribution is about $30. Some give more, most give far less. All that matters is that you make that donation, if you can. Can I count on you? Anything you can give will be split with Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55397?t=7&akid=22369%2E4449941%2ENuXZhA) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55398?t=8&akid=22369%2E4449941%2ENuXZhA)

You have my word, we’ll put every dollar to good use.

Thanks a lot,

-RG

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Tuesday: Rural Evangelicals for Harris Call
body:
Join Call With Rural Believers Tue. Oct. 22 | |
---
| | | As a reminder, you are warmly invited to join us for a [Rural Evangelicals for Harris supporter zoom call](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=81c7cd2c35&e=43463f1dee) tomorrow - Tuesday October 22 from 8 – 9 pm ET.

Developed by and for rural and agricultural families and those who support them, **please **[**join us**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=95fe6f6801&e=43463f1dee)** and other rural believers for prayer, encouragement, and discussion of Harris/Walz administration policies that will benefit rural and agricultural families and communities. **We’ll also discuss ways **Evangelicals for Harris supporters can do more to elect Harris and Walz in these final weeks before the election.**

This is an off the record conversation.

Please register [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=7330a44e68&e=43463f1dee). We look forward to seeing you Tuesday October 22 from 8-9 pm ET.

_**"Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."**_(Joshua 1:9)

Thank you for your courage and all you're doing to support Harris and Walz. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

Friend –
Many people have been asking me... **_Who is Shawn Harris?_**

_Shawn Harris: My propped up Democrat opponent_

**“We're building a coalition from across the country,**
**united in our goal to**** __unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene__****.”**
** _\- Shawn Harris_**

My friends at the DSCC are doing everything they can to save our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority, and with just 15 days left before the election, every little bit helps. [So can I count on you to chip in $5 _(matched to become $15)_ to defend the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/20382?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241021-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241021-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&akid=18411%2E9716520%2E-R5o_i)**

As an activist, I know that **the greatest American victories of our time rarely came all at once.** They were the culmination of years or even decades of work, all with the goal of making our country a little more perfect -- one seemingly small act at a time.

Last year, Tennessee lawmakers pushed a bill that would have banned hanging any flag in classrooms except for national and state flags. **This included Pride flags: symbols of love, acceptance, and support for so many LGBTQ+ kids.** That bill passed the Tennessee House but narrowly failed in the State Senate — a terrifyingly close call. If it passed, it would have sent a message to LGBTQ+ students that their existence and identity aren't worthy of recognition in their own schools — and that it must be hidden away. _**This is why local elections matter.**_ They determine not just who sits in office, but what our communities look like — whether our kids feel supported or marginalized and whether our schools are spaces of inclusion or exclusion. That’s why my team has been working relentlessly to canvas up and down the ballot — to ensure that progressive candidates at every level has the support they need. **We’re not just focused on Congress; we’re committed to ensuring our local and state governments are led by those who believe in justice, inclusion, and equity.** Our work is fueled by supporters like you, Peter — folks who understand the stakes of our local elections, from city councils to school boards to state legislatures. clean_body: Our communities should be led with justice, inclusion, and equity. | | Hi Peter, We hear time and time again that local elections matter , but I want to share why I believe this so strongly — and why I’ve been with my team on the front lines, organizing tirelessly for races up and down the ballot. Last year, Tennessee lawmakers pushed a bill that would have banned hanging any flag in classrooms except for national and state flags. This included Pride flags: symbols of love, acceptance, and support for so many LGBTQ+ kids. That bill passed the Tennessee House but narrowly failed in the State Senate — a terrifyingly close call. If it passed, it would have sent a message to LGBTQ+ students that their existence and identity aren't worthy of recognition in their own schools — and that it must be hidden away. This is why local elections matter. They determine not just who sits in office, but what our communities look like — whether our kids feel supported or marginalized and whether our schools are spaces of inclusion or exclusion. That’s why my team has been working relentlessly to canvas up and down the ballot — to ensure that progressive candidates at every level has the support they need. We’re not just focused on Congress; we’re committed to ensuring our local and state governments are led by those who believe in justice, inclusion, and equity. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why I always say this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I just about always sign these with the same message.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2378%2E4032634%2EN1RCZu)
---
You might have noticed something about these emails that you get from me. I just about always sign them with the same message: “Thanks for being a part of this.” And I mean it. I’m deeply grateful that you are a part of this fight. A part of this movement. A part of this campaign. Whenever I think about all the ways that so many people contribute to building a better country, I’m in awe — and I’m inspired to stay in the fight. Whether you knock on doors or share articles about our work, whether you chip in $3 or $30 or $300, whether you joined this team for my first Senate race or you’re all in for this re-election campaign — you are just as much a part of this effort as anyone else. We make big change by making it together — from creating the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to getting student debt canceled to putting a new tax on giant corporations (which helped fund our nation’s biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change). And we’re still building something greater than the sum of its parts. You’re a part of a team that will help hold onto our Senate majority, fight back against MAGA extremism, and continue to fight for the bold action that working families need — like national abortion protections, a wealth tax, universal child care, a judicial code of ethics, and much more. And part of a team that will continue to win. As long as we keep fighting side by side. [**In order to keep fighting this righteous fight, can you make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign? This is a grassroots-powered campaign, so the only way we can keep making big change is if everyone pitches in whatever they can, whenever they can.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2777?amount=28&t=8&akid=2378%2E4032634%2EN1RCZu)

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas juror who voted to convict Robert Roberson: 'I would have found him not guilty'** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Bayliss Wagner** and**John C. Moritz** -- "After a dramatic flurry of weekend court filings, the Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee on Monday opted to delay hearing testimony from death row inmate **Robert Roberson** , scuttling a controversial plan that drew national attention and avoiding what might have been a developing constitutional crisis in state government.

But the committee did hear from one member of the jury that convicted Roberson, who told the panel that if she had known of new evidence that calls into question the foundational premise of the trial -- that the condemned man had killed his daughter by shaking her to death -- she would have voted to set him free at trial.

"Everything that was presented to us was all about shaken baby syndrome. That is what our decision was based on," former juror **Terre Compton** testified Monday. "Nothing else was ever presented to us to consider. If it had been ... I would have found him not guilty."

The change in plans came after Gov. **Greg Abbott o** n Monday morning broke weeks of silence on one of the most controversial death penalty cases in recent history, telling the Texas Supreme Court that the House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee had overstepped its authority and encroached on powers that are rightfully his.

Abbott's [court filing](https://substack.com/redirect/2bb967d7-9a2f-42dd-abbe-e815772bea47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) takes issue with the last-minute stay of execution the Texas Supreme Court ordered Thursday to allow Roberson time to appear before the House committee, which voted unanimously Wednesday to subpoena the death row inmate as part of its investigation into the "junk science" law. Lawmakers say they believe Roberson was convicted with a faulty diagnosis of shaken baby syndrome in the death of his 2-year-old daughter, **Nikk** i, more than two decades ago.

In lieu of in-person or remote testimony from Roberson, an inmate with autism who has been locked away in solitary confinement since being condemned in 2003, the House committee heard hours of testimony from expert witnesses, including television personality **Phil McGraw** , better known as Dr. Phil, and best-selling author and attorney**John Grisham**.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/71825a0f-8828-4f52-a16e-2a6200df6376?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
McGraw, a mental health professional who studied Roberson's case, told lawmakers that studies debunking shaken baby syndrome as junk science and his death row meeting with Roberson have left him convinced that Texas was on the verge of executing an innocent man.

"I believe that in the United States of America, if we are going to deprive someone of their liberty, that comes at a very high standard," McGraw said. "If we are going to deprive someone of their life, that comes at a very high standard, a very high standard of proof, a very high standard of evidence."

He said that standard has not been met in Roberson's case.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/71825a0f-8828-4f52-a16e-2a6200df6376?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The change in plans also comes after Attorney General **Ken Paxton's** office asked the Texas Supreme Court to throw out the House panel's subpoena entirely, reversing its Thursday order. The court declined to rule on the motion over the weekend and instead asked the House and the attorney general to file merit briefs next week.

Committee Chairman **Joe Moody** , D-El Paso, said that the House panel could have taken a "heavy-handed approach" to enforcing its subpoena, but that it decided against it. Moody held open the possibility that the committee would hear directly from Roberson at an unspecified later date.

"We didn't issue the subpoena to create a constitutional crisis, and we aren't interested in escalating a division between branches of government," Moody said. "In fact, we have the greatest respect for every other facet of our government, and we want to make and we want all of them to come together in our purpose here, which is making sure that Robert is heard."

Moody's Republican colleagues also nodded to concerns about separation of powers that the executive branch raised but maintained that the subpoena was a necessary measure.

Rep. **Jeff Leach** , R-Plano, said the committee issued the subpoena and convened Monday not only to understand how the justice system "failed Mr. Roberson," but also "to make sure that it never happens again."

Leach also said he has gone from having "questions and concerns" about the man's conviction to "believing he is 'fully innocent.'"" [AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/7697ed76-d49c-47d8-8156-402659ba1b46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS "Texas juror who voted to convict Robert Roberson: 'I would have found him not guilty' ," Austin American-Statesman's Bayliss Wagner andJohn C. Moritz -- "After a dramatic flurry of weekend court filings, the Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee on Monday opted to delay hearing testimony from death row inmate Robert Roberson , scuttling a controversial plan that drew national attention and avoiding what might have been a developing constitutional crisis in state government. But the committee did hear from one member of the jury that convicted Roberson, who told the panel that if she had known of new evidence that calls into question the foundational premise of the trial -- that the condemned man had killed his daughter by shaking her to death -- she would have voted to set him free at trial. "Everything that was presented to us was all about shaken baby syndrome. That is what our decision was based on," former juror Terre Compton testified Monday. "Nothing else was ever presented to us to consider. If it had been ... I would have found him not guilty." The change in plans came after Gov. Greg Abbott o n Monday morning broke weeks of silence on one of the most controversial death penalty cases in recent history, telling the Texas Supreme Court that the House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee had overstepped its authority and encroached on powers that are rightfully his. Abbott's takes issue with the last-minute stay of execution the Texas Supreme Court ordered Thursday to allow Roberson time to appear before the House committee, which voted unanimously Wednesday to subpoena the death row inmate as part of its investigation into the "junk science" law. Lawmakers say they believe Roberson was convicted with a faulty diagnosis of shaken baby syndrome in the death of his 2-year-old daughter, Nikk i, more than two decades ago. In lieu of in-person or remote testimony from Roberson, an inmate with autism who has been locked away in solitary confinement since being condemned in 2003, the House committee heard hours of testimony from expert witnesses, including television personality Phil McGraw , better known as Dr. Phil, and best-selling author and attorneyJohn Grisham. McGraw, a mental health professional who studied Roberson's case, told lawmakers that studies debunking shaken baby syndrome as junk science and his death row meeting with Roberson have left him convinced that Texas was on the verge of executing an innocent man. "I believe that in the United States of America, if we are going to deprive someone of their liberty, that comes at a very high standard," McGraw said. "If we are going to deprive someone of their life, that comes at a very high standard, a very high standard of proof, a very high standard of evidence." He said that standard has not been met in Roberson's case. The change in plans also comes after Attorney General Ken Paxton's office asked the Texas Supreme Court to throw out the House panel's subpoena entirely, reversing its Thursday order. The court declined to rule on the motion over the weekend and instead asked the House and the attorney general to file merit briefs next week. Committee Chairman Joe Moody , D-El Paso, said that the House panel could have taken a "heavy-handed approach" to enforcing its subpoena, but that it decided against it. Moody held open the possibility that the committee would hear directly from Roberson at an unspecified later date. "We didn't issue the subpoena to create a constitutional crisis, and we aren't interested in escalating a division between branches of government," Moody said. "In fact, we have the greatest respect for every other facet of our government, and we want to make and we want all of them to come together in our purpose here, which is making sure that Robert is heard." Moody's Republican colleagues also nodded to concerns about separation of powers that the executive branch raised but maintained that the subpoena was a necessary measure. Rep. Jeff Leach , R-Plano, said the committee issued the subpoena and convened Monday not only to understand how the justice system "failed Mr. Roberson," but also "to make sure that it never happens again." Leach also said he has gone from having "questions and concerns" about the man's conviction to "believing he is 'fully innocent.'"" "Everything that was presented to us was all about shaken baby syndrome. That is what our decision was based on," former juror **Terre Compton** testified Monday. "Nothing else was ever presented to us to consider. If it had been ... I would have found him not guilty."

The change in plans came after Gov. **Greg Abbott o** n Monday morning broke weeks of silence on one of the most controversial death penalty cases in recent history, telling the Texas Supreme Court that the House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee had overstepped its authority and encroached on powers that are rightfully his.

Abbott's [court filing](https://substack.com/redirect/37feb6cd-dc01-4fe5-9bf3-c85ef24d1ab0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) takes issue with the last-minute stay of execution the Texas Supreme Court ordered Thursday to allow Roberson time to appear before the House committee, which voted unanimously Wednesday to subpoena the death row inmate as part of its investigation into the "junk science" law. Lawmakers say they believe Roberson was convicted with a faulty diagnosis of shaken baby syndrome in the death of his 2-year-old daughter, **Nikk** i, more than two decades ago.

In lieu of in-person or remote testimony from Roberson, an inmate with autism who has been locked away in solitary confinement since being condemned in 2003, the House committee heard hours of testimony from expert witnesses, including television personality **Phil McGraw** , better known as Dr. Phil, and best-selling author and attorney**John Grisham**.

McGraw, a mental health professional who studied Roberson's case, told lawmakers that studies debunking shaken baby syndrome as junk science and his death row meeting with Roberson have left him convinced that Texas was on the verge of executing an innocent man.

"I believe that in the United States of America, if we are going to deprive someone of their liberty, that comes at a very high standard," McGraw said. "If we are going to deprive someone of their life, that comes at a very high standard, a very high standard of proof, a very high standard of evidence."

He said that standard has not been met in Roberson's case.

The change in plans also comes after Attorney General **Ken Paxton's** office asked the Texas Supreme Court to throw out the House panel's subpoena entirely, reversing its Thursday order. The court declined to rule on the motion over the weekend and instead asked the House and the attorney general to file merit briefs next week.

Committee Chairman **Joe Moody** , D-El Paso, said that the House panel could have taken a "heavy-handed approach" to enforcing its subpoena, but that it decided against it. Moody held open the possibility that the committee would hear directly from Roberson at an unspecified later date.

"We didn't issue the subpoena to create a constitutional crisis, and we aren't interested in escalating a division between branches of government," Moody said. "In fact, we have the greatest respect for every other facet of our government, and we want to make and we want all of them to come together in our purpose here, which is making sure that Robert is heard."

Moody's Republican colleagues also nodded to concerns about separation of powers that the executive branch raised but maintained that the subpoena was a necessary measure.

Rep. **Jeff Leach** , R-Plano, said the committee issued the subpoena and convened Monday not only to understand how the justice system "failed Mr. Roberson," but also "to make sure that it never happens again."

Leach also said he has gone from having "questions and concerns" about the man's conviction to "believing he is 'fully innocent.'"" [AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/3b2a3350-9ae6-4f4c-b2b7-071f0ddd9192?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

## Team Hunley:
The countdown to Election Day is on! We need you to volunteer. Here are a few ways to get involved.

**CANVASS: **

We're going door-to-door throughout Marion County and we need **as many volunteers as possible** so that we can reach all of our target voters! Please sign up for our canvasses at the links below. [Sign up to Canvass in Pike Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=2b9dfde915&e=d9ebccf591) [Sign up to Canvass in Washington Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=2aa4a0ed86&e=d9ebccf591) [Sign up to Canvass in Lawrence Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=bf73a28ef5&e=d9ebccf591) [Sign up to Canvass in Wayne Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=34edd2e01f&e=d9ebccf591) [Sign up to Canvass in Center Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=fbd4389689&e=d9ebccf591) [Sign up to Canvass in Warren Township](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=64cc4313db&e=d9ebccf591)
**PHONEBANK:**

[Sign up to Phonebank (from home) for Jennifer McMcCormick for Governor ](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=e998b0c8ab&e=d9ebccf591)

If you're feeling anxious about the election, as those results roll in, you will want to know that you did all that you could to help ensure the candidates you support get across the finish line.

Let's do this!
Andrea
